questions.text: Beatriz has planned the following activities for her reading session: • The teacher writes the title of a text and asks the students to figure out what it is about. • The teacher writes some of the students' ideas on the board. • The teacher gives the students some minutes to read the text and decide if those ideas are right or wrong. Which reading skill is NOT being reinforced with the activities presented?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque la secuencia incluye predicting mediante el título y la posterior lectura para comprobar hipótesis, además de una lectura orientada a la idea general. En ningún momento se pide localizar datos específicos.

A es incorrecta porque verificar de qué trata el texto mediante una lectura global puede reforzar skimming.

C es incorrecta porque scanning requiere buscar información puntual y concreta, algo que la actividad no solicita.

TIP / RECUERDA: No confundas comprobar una predicción con buscar un detalle específico: la segunda acción es scanning.

questions.text: Ernesto's students have been practicing "Relating past events" lately. Now, the teacher wants to promote this language function through a meaningful speaking activity. Given the teacher's goal, which of the following activities is appropriate?
options: The students read a short interview of a famous person on his/her early years. The teacher tells them to highlight the questions and expressions used in the interview to inquire about past events and describe them. Finally, the students work in pairs and use the questions and expressions to interview each other.

The students listen to the audio of a short story narrated in the past tense. The teacher tells the students to take notes as they listen. Then the teacher puts the students in groups and tells them to use their notes to reconstruct the story. Once they finish, one representative of the team reads the story to the rest of the class.

The students look at a picture of a family that lived in the 1950s. The teacher writes on the board sentences with "used to + infinitive" to describe the family's routines at that time. He explains that this structure is used to talk about past habits. The students write more sentences on that family using "used to" and then read their examples to the class.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque los estudiantes reutilizan preguntas y expresiones para entrevistarse mutuamente sobre acontecimientos pasados, generando una interacción oral con propósito comunicativo.

B es incorrecta porque la reconstrucción de la historia a partir de notas termina en una producción que no genera la misma interacción oral entre interlocutores.

C es incorrecta porque centra la actividad en la explicación y repetición de la estructura "used to", más que en la comunicación significativa de acontecimientos pasados.

TIP / RECUERDA: Una speaking activity significativa necesita intercambio de significado, no solo práctica de formas.

questions.text: Antonia's students are going to debate on the statement "Junk food should be banned in schools." She wants her students to use the following expressions while debating: • I beg your pardon? • Sorry to butt in, but... • I don't quite see what you mean. • Can I add something here? Which two language functions does Antonia want her students to practice?
options: Asking for information / arranging one's ideas.
Expressing lack of understanding / interrupting someone.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque "I beg your pardon?" y "I don't quite see what you mean" expresan lack of understanding, mientras que "Sorry to butt in" y "Can I add something here?" permiten interrumpir cortésmente.

A es incorrecta porque las expresiones no asignan blame ni presentan una función principal de apologizing.

B es incorrecta porque no están orientadas a pedir información ni a organizar ideas, sino a aclarar la comprensión y tomar el turno.

TIP / RECUERDA: En preguntas de language functions, separa la intención de cada expresión de su contenido literal.

questions.text: Tina's students have been talking about their favorite dish. Now, she wants them to participate in a communicative oral activity using that topic. Which of the following strategies is it more appropriate to carry out?
options: The students write the recipe of their favorite dish in their notebooks. Next, they read it aloud to the whole class. Finally, the teacher invites some volunteers to recall the ingredients mentioned in the recipe.

The students record a video in which they give instructions to prepare their favorite dish. The teacher asks the students to use simple language for their classmates to understand the instructions given. Finally, the teacher plays some of the videos in class.

The students ask five peers what their favorite dish is, why they like it and what ingredients it is made of. Then they compare and analyze the answers they got in order to find out similarities and differences. Finally, the students share their findings with the class.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque obliga a los estudiantes a obtener información real de varios compañeros, compararla y comunicar conclusiones. Hay un propósito, interacción y negociación de significado: elementos de communicative competence.

A es incorrecta porque escribir y leer una receta al resto de la clase produce principalmente monólogos y recuperación de información.

B es incorrecta porque grabar un video con instrucciones genera una producción, pero no el intercambio bidireccional de información que caracteriza la opción C.

TIP / RECUERDA: Comunicativo no significa solo "hablar"; implica hablar para lograr un propósito con otra persona.

questions.text:
During the past few sessions, Maribel's fourth-grade students have been discussing about the impact reality shows have on teenagers. Now, they will write a short essay on that topic following the Process approach to writing.

First, Maribel wants her students to generate written ideas for their essays. Taking her purpose into account, which of the following strategies is it NOT appropriate to carry out?
options: Give each student a copy of an empty chart about the impact of reality shows on teenagers. The chart has the following labels: "Pros" and "Cons." Ask the students to write phrases under each label and then elaborate on those phrases to develop their essays.

Provide each student with a short essay that criticizes reality shows and their impact on teenagers. Tell them to read it quickly and highlight the arguments they find relevant. Ask the students to use these highlighted arguments as the main arguments of their essays.

Ask the students to write a paragraph that includes all the ideas they have about the impact of reality shows on teenagers. Give the students five minutes to write as much as they can without stopping. Ask them not to pay attention to errors related to spelling, grammar, or punctuation.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque el Process approach exige que las ideas del texto se generen y desarrollen progresivamente por el propio estudiante. Tomar los argumentos de un ensayo ajeno como base principal no desarrolla esa generación autónoma de ideas.

A es incorrecta porque un chart de pros y cons funciona como organizador de ideas y facilita la planificación del propio texto.

C es incorrecta porque el freewriting permite producir ideas rápidamente sin detenerse inicialmente en errores de forma, una estrategia válida de pre-writing.

TIP / RECUERDA: En Process Writing, distingue pre-writing, drafting, revising y editing; la generación de ideas debe preceder a la redacción.

questions.text:
During the next session, Maribel asks the students to make the outline for their essays. While she is giving the instructions for the activity, she hears the following comments from three students: Marco: "Outlines are not necessary." Andrea: "Yes, we need to concentrate on writing the final version." Teresa: "I will write the outline at the end."

Maribel wants her students to reflect on the benefits of making an outline before writing an essay. Given this goal, which of the following set of questions is more appropriate to ask the students?
options: • How can you use an outline to organize your ideas when you start writing your draft? • What kind of problems can you avoid if you make an outline? • Don't you think it may be worth writing an outline then?
• Is it difficult for you to control your time when writing? • How long does it take you to make an outline? • Has making the outline at the end always worked for you?
• What are the steps of the writing process? • Is it okay to skip one of those steps? • Don't you think it is important to follow the order of the writing process?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque sus preguntas hacen que los estudiantes relacionen el outline con una función concreta: organizar ideas, prevenir problemas y facilitar el drafting. Esto promueve reflexión y metacognition.

B es incorrecta porque centra la reflexión en el manejo del tiempo, no en la utilidad del outline para organizar el texto.

C es incorrecta porque se enfoca en seguir etapas y en si pueden omitirse, pero no lleva directamente a descubrir los beneficios de planificar con un outline.

TIP / RECUERDA: Para promover metacognition, pregunta por la utilidad de una estrategia y sus efectos en la tarea.

questions.text: Karina's students are participating in a speaking activity. They are answering the question: "What would you do if you won the lottery?" She asks her students to answer with the following expressions: • If only ... I would... • Imagine that you won... • I'd rather... • Don't you think you could...? Which of the following language functions is NOT involved in the expressions provided?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque ninguna de las expresiones se utiliza para resumir información. "If only...", "Imagine that..." e "I'd rather..." expresan deseos, hipótesis o preferencias, y "Don't you think you could...?" puede introducir una sugerencia.

B es incorrecta porque "If only..." e "I'd rather..." pueden expresar wishes or preferences, por lo que esta función sí está presente.

C es incorrecta porque "Don't you think you could...?" puede utilizarse para hacer suggestions, por lo que tampoco es la función ausente.

TIP / RECUERDA: Elige la función que no aparece en ninguna expresión, no la que sea menos frecuente.

questions.text: Genesis' students are going to give an oral presentation about "Technology and employment opportunities." She asks her students to use the following expressions in their presentations: • To return to... • As I mentioned earlier,... • Anyway, as I said before,... Which of the following language functions corresponds to the expressions Genesis wants her students to use?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque las tres expresiones sirven para volver a un punto previamente mencionado y reorientar la presentación hacia ese contenido. Esa es la función de getting back to the point.

A es incorrecta porque making predictions requiere lenguaje orientado al futuro o a posibles resultados, no marcadores de retorno discursivo.

B es incorrecta porque aunque una referencia previa puede destacar información, la función específica de estas expresiones es retomar un punto anterior, no simplemente enfatizarlo.

TIP / RECUERDA: Expresiones como "as I mentioned earlier" señalan organización discursiva, no predicción.

questions.text: Before playing the audio, Patricia wants to do a warm-up activity related to video games. Which of the following warm-up activities is it NOT appropriate to carry out?
options: Ask the students to make a graphic organizer about the history of video games in their notebooks. Once the students finish, tell them to exchange their graphic organizers with a partner. Ask the students to give each other suggestions on how to improve their graphic organizers.

Bring copies of a word search puzzle that contains vocabulary related to video games. Pair up the students and give each pair a word search puzzle for them to find together the words as fast as possible. When they finish, ask them to mention which topic the vocabulary is related to.

Pair up the students and give them a piece of paper for them to write the names of their favorite video games. When they finish writing, collect the pieces of paper and put them in a bag. One at a time, take some pieces of paper and ask the whole class what they know about the video games written on those papers.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque un warm-up debe preparar el tema de manera breve y activar a los estudiantes sin consumir una parte importante de la sesión. Elaborar y revisar una graphic organizer sobre la historia de los videojuegos es demasiado extensa y demandante para esa función.

B es incorrecta porque el word search es breve, lúdico y permite activar vocabulario relacionado con el tema.

C es incorrecta porque recuperar nombres de videojuegos favoritos activa conocimiento e interés de manera rápida, por lo que encaja mejor como warm-up.

TIP / RECUERDA: Warm-up = breve, motivador y conectado con el tema; no debe convertirse en la tarea central.

questions.text: Now, Patricia will play the audio for the first time. She gives her students the following instructions: "Now, I will play an audio about the benefits of playing video games. In this audio, you will listen to three different news reports that mention the positive effects of video games on people's lives." What is Patricia's purpose when giving the instructions above?
options: Setting the scene of the audio.
Making sure the students stay on task.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque la docente informa de qué tratará el audio y cómo está organizado. Esa información prepara el contexto y ayuda a los estudiantes a anticipar el contenido: setting the scene.

B es incorrecta porque "stay on task" se refiere al manejo de la conducta o atención durante la actividad, no a contextualizar el input.

C es incorrecta porque scaffolding implica proporcionar apoyos que faciliten la realización de la tarea; aquí la función principal es presentar el contexto del audio.

TIP / RECUERDA: Setting the scene prepara el contexto; scaffolding ofrece apoyo para poder realizar una tarea.

questions.text: Then the students are going to listen to the audio for the second time. Patricia asks them to identify the following information: • Two benefits of playing video games. • Two institutions that did research on video games. Which of the following listening skills is Patricia trying to promote with her activity?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque los estudiantes deben identificar datos concretos: beneficios específicos e instituciones. Eso exige listening for specific information.

A es incorrecta porque listening for gist busca comprender de qué trata el audio en términos generales, no localizar varios datos puntuales.

B es incorrecta porque interpreting information supone inferir o construir significado más allá de la información explícita; aquí se pide localizar información específica.

questions.text: Next, Patricia wants her students to reflect on the content of the audio. Which of the following questions is NOT appropriate to ask?
options: Why playing video games can make you a better driver?
Should teenagers be encouraged to play video games? Why/Why not?
Would you be willing to play video games to improve some of your skills? Support your answer.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque la pregunta está formulada de manera incorrecta ("Why playing video games can...?") y además plantea una estructura que no corresponde a una pregunta gramaticalmente completa.

B es incorrecta porque invita a valorar una afirmación del audio y justificar una postura, lo que sí promueve reflexión crítica.

C es incorrecta porque pide al estudiante tomar una posición personal y sustentarla, también apropiado para una actividad de reflexión post-escucha.

TIP / RECUERDA: En preguntas de reflexión, revisa también la calidad lingüística de la pregunta antes de valorar su propósito pedagógico.

questions.text: Now, Patricia wants to wrap-up her session. Which of the following activities is appropriate to achieve her purpose?
options: The teacher asks the students to make a concept map on the information they learned in today's session.
The teacher asks the students to paraphrase, in their notebooks, one of the news reports they listened to in today's session.
The teacher asks the students to mention three things they have learned, two things they think about the topic and one question they still have about the topic.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque la estrategia 3-2-1 permite cerrar la sesión rápidamente y hacer visible qué aprendieron, qué piensan y qué dudas permanecen. Esto favorece la metacognition.

A es incorrecta porque elaborar un concept map puede ser útil, pero requiere más tiempo y es menos adecuado para un cierre breve.

B es incorrecta porque paraphrasing es una tarea de producción y procesamiento del contenido, no una estrategia de wrap-up tan directa como la reflexión 3-2-1.

TIP / RECUERDA: Un buen cierre recupera aprendizaje y reflexión, no necesariamente añade una tarea extensa.

questions.text: The students have been learning how to describe things. Their teacher wants to help them reinforce their oral ability through a communicative activity in which they describe something in detail. Given this goal, which of the following strategies is least appropriate?
options: The teacher pastes the picture of an object on the board. He tells the students they have to describe its characteristics. They observe the picture for some minutes and then the teacher calls for the students' participation.

The teacher puts the students in groups. One student in the group picks a vocabulary card and describes the characteristics of the object in the card without saying its name. The other members of the group try to guess what the object is, and then they switch roles.

The teacher puts the students in pairs. In each pair, student A receives the picture of a room, and student B gets the picture of the same room with some small differences. Without looking at each other's picture, the students describe what they see and try to find out the differences.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque el estudiante describe la imagen principalmente para el docente y no existe un information gap ni una necesidad real de intercambiar información. Por eso es la menos comunicativa.

B es incorrecta porque adivinar el objeto exige escuchar la descripción y responder con información del interlocutor, generando interacción.

C es incorrecta porque las diferencias entre imágenes crean un information gap: cada estudiante posee información que el otro necesita.

TIP / RECUERDA: Para identificar una actividad realmente comunicativa, busca propósito, interacción e information gap.

questions.text: Sonia's students are going to design a poster about recycling in order to make the school community aware of how important it is. To help the students design their posters, she brings different samples. Here are two of the activities she does during the session: • The teacher groups the students and gives each group two sample posters for them to analyze the features (language conventions, style, organization, etc.). • Once familiar with the features analyzed, each group designs their poster using the samples as models. Based on the activities presented above, which approach to writing is the teacher using?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque el teacher proporciona modelos de póster y pide a los estudiantes analizarlos para producir uno semejante. Ese énfasis en el modelo y en el producto final caracteriza el Product approach.

A es incorrecta porque Process approach se organiza alrededor de etapas como pre-writing, drafting, revising y editing.

C es incorrecta porque Genre approach no se reduce a imitar un modelo; además de la estructura, considera propósito, audiencia y convenciones del género.

TIP / RECUERDA: Product approach = modelo y producto; Process approach = etapas; Genre approach = propósito, audiencia y convenciones del género.

questions.text: Emerson will get his students involved in writing by having them email a contemporary writer they admire. He has designed the following sequence: • The teacher asks for the students' favorite young adult contemporary books and takes notes on the board. • After that, the teacher asks the students to do some research on the writer of their favorite book. They go to the computer lab to make a brief search on the web. • Later, the teacher tells them that they are going to write an email to their favorite young adult contemporary writer to comment on his/her work. • In their notebooks, they list the comments they would like to send. Using their lists, the students write an email draft while the teacher monitors the activity helping out when necessary. • Then the teacher pairs up the students and asks them to share the comments they wrote. They analyze the language included in their drafts. • Finally, the students look for the author's contact information and send him/her the final version of their email. In the teaching sequence above, what is the teaching method applied?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque la secuencia gira alrededor de una tarea real y significativa: investigar, redactar y enviar un email a un escritor. Incluye preparación, realización y análisis posterior de la lengua, rasgos propios del Task-Based Learning.

B es incorrecta porque PPP organiza la enseñanza como Presentation--Practice--Production y no es el eje que estructura esta secuencia.

C es incorrecta porque Content-Based Instruction usa una lengua extranjera para aprender contenido disciplinar; aquí el contenido no constituye el objetivo central, sino que sirve de contexto para la tarea de escritura.

TIP / RECUERDA: En TBL, identifica una task con propósito comunicativo claro y un resultado concreto.

questions.text: Bruno wants his students to use the following expressions in a conversation: "In other words,...", "To put it differently,..." and "Let me put it in another way." Which of the following language functions is Bruno trying to promote?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque las tres expresiones reformulan una idea con palabras diferentes para hacerla más clara al interlocutor. Esa es la función de giving clarifications.

B es incorrecta porque ninguna expresión pretende ordenar o exigir una acción.

C es incorrecta porque tampoco propone una acción o alternativa futura; su propósito es aclarar una idea ya expresada.

TIP / RECUERDA: "In other words..." y expresiones similares son marcadores de reformulación y clarification.

questions.text: Greta's fifth-grade students have been discussing about values they consider important. In that context, she wants her students to develop their writing skills. Which of the following activities is least appropriate to achieve the teacher's purpose?
options: In groups, the students make a "word cloud" about values. The teacher asks the students to draw a cloud on a flipchart and tells them to fill in the cloud with words related to the topic. She highlights that the words they consider most important should be written with bigger letters in order to stand out from the other words.

In groups, the students design a survey to find out which values are important among their schoolmates. They should write questions to identify the values the surveyed students have. Then, as homework, each student runs the survey, analyzes the answers and writes some conclusions.

In groups, the students write the script of a TV spot that points out similarities and differences between their own values and the values their parents had when they were teenagers. The teacher asks the students to include catchy ideas for the audience to get interested in the topic.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque una word cloud organiza palabras de manera visual, pero no exige producir un texto escrito con desarrollo, organización y propósito comunicativo.

B es incorrecta porque diseñar preguntas de una encuesta y redactar conclusiones sí requiere producción escrita funcional.

C es incorrecta porque escribir un guion para un TV spot exige organizar ideas, redactar mensajes y considerar una audiencia.

TIP / RECUERDA: Activar vocabulario no equivale necesariamente a desarrollar writing.

questions.text: Ana wants to help her students improve their speaking fluency through a group discussion. During the discussion, Ana wants her students to use the following expressions: • Why do you think so? • That's interesting! • Tell me more. Which of the following language functions is involved in the expressions above?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque "Why do you think so?", "That's interesting!" y "Tell me more" mantienen la interacción, muestran interés y piden al interlocutor que amplíe su idea. Su función es keep a discussion going.

A es incorrecta porque las expresiones no expresan directamente agreement or disagreement.

C es incorrecta porque no buscan convencer al interlocutor de una postura; facilitan que la conversación continúe.

TIP / RECUERDA: Expressions that ask for elaboration or show active listening often serve to keep a discussion going.

questions.text: Fernanda's students are having a conversation in which they are using the following expressions: • Hey, what happened? • I swear I didn't mean to be late. • Did you miss the bus or something? • I hope you didn't wait for a long time. Which language function is NOT involved in the expressions provided?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque el diálogo contiene preguntas para pedir explicaciones y expresiones relacionadas con disculparse, pero no una promesa de realizar una acción futura.

A es incorrecta porque "What happened?" y "Did you miss the bus or something?" buscan una explicación de lo ocurrido.

B es incorrecta porque "I swear I didn't mean to be late" y "I hope you didn't wait..." aparecen dentro de un intercambio de disculpa y reparación de la situación.

TIP / RECUERDA: Una promise implica compromiso futuro, por ejemplo "I'll..."; no basta con expresar arrepentimiento.

questions.text:
Margarita, one of Rodrigo's students, has handed in the first version of her review. Here is an excerpt of her text: "Hey dudes! Let me to recommend to you the restaurant "Doña Paquita", is so crazy! All the waiters in the restaurant is super cool too and I felt happy when I went..."

Margarita has used expressions such as "Hey dudes", "so crazy" and "super cool", which do not belong to a formal register. The teacher wants to give Margarita some feedback on this issue to promote the student's self-correction of her mistakes. Which of the following written feedback is more appropriate to achieve the teacher's purpose?
options: "I have circled all the informal words in your review. Please replace them with more appropriate words, considering that your review should adopt a formal register."
"I have underlined the informal words I found in your review and have replaced them with more formal words. Please write your text again using the words I gave you."
"I have noticed some informal words in your review, such as 'dudes.' Please look for any other informal words in your text and replace them with words that belong to a formal register."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque da un ejemplo ("dudes") y luego pide al estudiante identificar y reemplazar otros términos informales. Ese feedback es inductivo y favorece self-correction y autonomía.

A es incorrecta porque el docente identifica todos los elementos informales y deja menos espacio para que la estudiante los descubra por sí misma.

B es incorrecta porque el docente sustituye directamente las palabras y entrega la solución, reduciendo la oportunidad de análisis y autocorrección.

TIP / RECUERDA: Para promover self-correction, señala una pista o ejemplo y deja que el estudiante descubra el resto del problema.

questions.text:
Rodrigo has made a checklist to assess his students' restaurant review. Here are three of the descriptors that appear in his checklist:

1. Linking words help understand the sequence of the text, whenever necessary. 2. Ideas in the text are related to the topic. There are no contradictions or missing information. 3. Accuracy is acceptable. There aren't many distracting errors.

Which of the descriptors above is appropriate to assess coherence in the students' written texts?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque la coherencia se refiere al sentido global del texto: relación con el tema, ausencia de contradicciones y presencia de información necesaria. Eso describe exactamente el descriptor 2.

A es incorrecta porque los linking words son recursos de cohesión que conectan partes del texto.

C es incorrecta porque accuracy se refiere a la corrección lingüística y a la cantidad de errores, no a la organización global de las ideas.

TIP / RECUERDA: Cohesion conecta; coherence da sentido global.

questions.text: Yolanda wants to help her students improve their speaking skills. Before starting a speaking practice, she provides them with the following expressions: "That's exactly how I feel" / "That's so true" / "You're absolutely right" / "You have a point there." Considering the expressions provided, which is the language function that Yolanda wants her students to practice?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque todas las expresiones manifiestan coincidencia o respaldo a lo dicho por otra persona. Su función comunicativa es expressing agreement.

A es incorrecta porque making suggestions implica proponer una acción o alternativa, algo que estas expresiones no hacen.

B es incorrecta porque persuading someone busca cambiar o reforzar la postura del interlocutor; aquí el hablante manifiesta que coincide.

TIP / RECUERDA: "You're absolutely right" y "You have a point" son señales claras de agreement.

questions.text: Marlon's students have been talking about movies using present perfect and simple past tenses. Now, he wants his students to develop their oral fluency in a freer way. He carries out the following sequence: • First, the teacher elicits some vocabulary related to movies and writes it on the board. Additionally, he elicits which forms are used to talk about recent past events. • Next, the teacher pairs up the students and tells them to ask each other questions to get information about the movie they have seen recently. • After the students have talked for some minutes, they stand up and look for a different classmate and repeat the procedure. • While the students are working, the teacher monitors. When he notices a student makes a mistake, he corrects the student on the spot. • Finally, on the board, the teacher writes some of the mistakes the students made during the activity and elicits the correct form from the students. Given the teacher's purpose, which of the following criticisms of this sequence is appropriate?
options: The teacher shouldn't have corrected the students' mistakes while they were performing the task.
The teacher shouldn't have written, on the board, the mistakes the students made during the activity and elicited the correct form.
The teacher shouldn't have recycled vocabulary related to the topic and reminded the structures used to talk about recent past events.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque el objetivo es oral fluency en una actividad relativamente libre; corregir cada error en el momento interrumpe el flujo, reduce la naturalidad y puede aumentar la inhibición del estudiante.

B es incorrecta porque recoger errores y analizarlos después de la interacción permite realizar delayed correction sin romper la fluidez durante la tarea.

C es incorrecta porque reciclar vocabulario y recordar estructuras antes de hablar proporciona preparación lingüística y puede facilitar una mejor producción.

TIP / RECUERDA: Fluency suele beneficiarse de delayed feedback; accuracy permite una corrección más focalizada.

questions.text: Johnny has planned the following strategy for the Pre-listening stage: • On the board, the teacher sticks pictures of people doing different activities to relax such as taking a walk, swimming, working out, etc. • Then he writes the following questions: "Do you do any of these things to relax?", "Which ones?" and "What else do you do to relax?" • The students discuss their answers in pairs. Finally, the teacher calls on some volunteers to share their answers. Which of the following is NOT a purpose of Johnny's Pre-listening stage?
options: Introducing the topic of the audio.
Having the students understand the listening text.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque en pre-listening se prepara al estudiante para escuchar mediante activación temática, conocimientos previos y expectativas. Comprender el texto auditivo todavía no puede ser el propósito principal porque el input aún no se ha escuchado.

A es incorrecta porque introducir el topic ayuda a contextualizar el audio.

B es incorrecta porque relacionar el tema con experiencias y conocimientos previos es precisamente una función del pre-listening.

TIP / RECUERDA: Pre-listening prepara; while-listening desarrolla la comprensión del input; post-listening extiende o integra el aprendizaje.

questions.text:
For the While-listening stage, the teacher will ask the students to listen to the audio of a reporter interviewing people on the street. Here is the audio he will play:

Speaker 1: "I am Roxana. I always go swimming to a public pool near my house. This activity is good for your lungs and..." Speaker 2: "Hello, I'm Natasha. I usually go to the gym two or three times a week and work out. It gets my mind off work and family problems and..." Speaker 3: "Hi! My name is Roger. When I feel stressed, I often go to the movies after work. I can go with friends or just by myself. I really enjoy the atmosphere of movie..." Speaker 4: "Hi, my name is Jacob. When I am stressed, I sometimes like to be outdoors. I like to take long walks in the park. It helps me relax and keeps me in good..."

Before playing the audio, Johnny gives the following instructions: "Listen to the four speakers and write down their names, the activities they do to relax and where they do those activities." Which of the following listening skills is the teacher trying to reinforce with his activity?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque los estudiantes deben identificar nombres, actividades y lugares concretos mencionados por los hablantes. Eso requiere listening for specific information.

A es incorrecta porque listening for gist buscaría identificar el tema o idea general del audio.

B es incorrecta porque inferring attitude exige interpretar emociones, intenciones o posturas; aquí la información se encuentra explícitamente en el discurso.

TIP / RECUERDA: Datos puntuales = specific information; idea global = gist.

questions.text: Next, Johnny wants to assess his students' listening comprehension of the audio. Which of the following activities is least appropriate to achieve his purpose?
options: The teacher writes, on the board, five scrambled sentences extracted from the audio. The students have to unscramble each sentence by organizing the words to form a logical sentence.

The teacher gives the students a worksheet with five True/False sentences about the content of the audio. The students write T (true) or F (false) and correct the false sentences by providing the right information.

The teacher gives each student a multiple choice quiz. It has five sentences related to the audio. Each sentence has a blank and each blank has three alternatives. The students read and choose the correct alternative for each sentence.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque ordenar palabras para reconstruir oraciones puede comprobar conocimiento sintáctico, pero no demuestra necesariamente que el estudiante comprendió el contenido del audio.

B es incorrecta porque las afirmaciones True/False sobre el contenido sí permiten comprobar comprensión auditiva y corregir información falsa.

C es incorrecta porque elegir la alternativa que completa correctamente una oración basada en el audio también puede verificar comprensión del contenido escuchado.

TIP / RECUERDA: Una tarea de listening debe evidenciar que el estudiante comprendió el input, no solo que puede manipular su forma lingüística.

questions.text: Finally, Johnny wants to carry out a Post-listening activity to help his students develop their productive skills. Which strategy is appropriate for the teacher's purpose?
options: The teacher asks the students to write some questions in order to interview a classmate on the activities he does to relax. Then, in pairs, they interview each other. Finally, they report their findings to the rest of the class.

The teacher writes, on the board, some comprehension questions about the audio. Then the students answer the questions and compare their answers in groups. Finally, each group reports their answers to the class.

The teacher gives the students a worksheet with incomplete sentences from the audio. The students complete the sentences individually. Finally, they compare their answers in pairs and read the sentences aloud.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque convierte la comprensión del audio en una interacción oral nueva: los estudiantes crean preguntas, entrevistan a un compañero y reportan información. Así desarrollan productive skills.

B es incorrecta porque responder preguntas de comprensión sigue centrado principalmente en la recepción y comprobación del contenido.

C es incorrecta porque completar oraciones extraídas del audio y leerlas en voz alta es una práctica controlada, no una producción comunicativa genuina.

TIP / RECUERDA: Post-listening productivo = usar lo comprendido para hablar o escribir con un nuevo propósito.

questions.text: Nelly's second-grade students are describing people they know using different adjectives. During the activity, one of her students says the following sentence: "My brother is sensible because he is kind and understands people's feelings." Aware of the student's mistake, Nelly wants to make a comment to help the student reflect on the use of the adjectives 'sensitive' and 'sensible.' Which of the following comments is appropriate to achieve Nelly's purpose?
options: "I understand what you want to say. However, using sensible instead of sensitive is a common mistake Spanish speakers usually make. In your example, the best adjective to use is sensitive."
"A psychologist is a sensitive person because he understands people's feelings. A judge is a sensible person because he judges based on evidence. Which adjective is better to use in your example?"

"Nice try! But, sensible refers to a person that is able to make good judgements based on reason and experience, not on emotion. You said that your brother is kind and understands people's feelings, so look for an adjective that really means that."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque contrasta "sensitive" y "sensible" mediante ejemplos claros y luego pide al estudiante decidir cuál corresponde a su mensaje. Es una estrategia inductiva que favorece la reflexión y la autocorrección.

A es incorrecta porque proporciona directamente la respuesta ("the best adjective is sensitive"), reduciendo la oportunidad de que el estudiante descubra la diferencia.

C es incorrecta porque explica la diferencia, pero deja la corrección menos guiada por contraste de contextos; B muestra ambos usos de forma explícita y permite seleccionar el adecuado.

TIP / RECUERDA: Los false friends se trabajan mejor contrastando significados en contextos, no solo traduciendo palabras.

questions.text: "has been completely blown (46)__________ of proportion."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque "blown out of proportion" es una fixed expression que significa presentar algo como más importante o grave de lo que realmente es.

A es incorrecta porque "blown down" no forma la colocación idiomática requerida en este contexto.

B es incorrecta porque "blown away" significa quedar muy impresionado o ser llevado por el viento, y no expresa la idea de exageración.

TIP / RECUERDA: En

questions.text: "Staying hydrated is definitely important, (47)___________ the idea that the simple act of drinking more water will make people healthier isn't true."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque "but" conecta dos cláusulas independientes y marca contraste entre la importancia de hidratarse y la afirmación que se niega después.

B es incorrecta porque "unlike" se usa para comparar o contrastar sustantivos o grupos nominales, no para enlazar estas dos cláusulas completas en esta posición.

C es incorrecta porque "despite" introduce normalmente una estructura nominal o gerundiva y no funciona aquí como conjunción coordinante entre las dos cláusulas.

TIP / RECUERDA: Para contrastar dos ideas completas, identifica el conector y la estructura que puede introducir.

questions.text: "hydration is the result of the good balance between electrolytes (48)___________ sodium and water in the body."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque "electrolytes like sodium" usa "like" para introducir un ejemplo: sodium es un tipo de electrolyte.

B es incorrecta porque "such" no completa por sí solo la expresión; para ejemplificar se requeriría "such as".

C es incorrecta porque "unlike" significa "a diferencia de" y establecería un contraste, cuando el texto necesita un ejemplo.

TIP / RECUERDA: "like + noun" puede introducir ejemplos en contextos de este tipo; "such as" también es una forma frecuente.

questions.text: "And you don't need to (49)__________ glass after glass of water throughout the day to maintain that balance."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque "chug" significa beber rápidamente o en grandes cantidades, sentido compatible con "glass after glass of water".

A es incorrecta porque "choke" significa atragantarse o asfixiarse, no beber repetidamente.

B es incorrecta porque "gasp" se refiere a jadear o tomar aire bruscamente, no a la acción de beber.

TIP / RECUERDA: En vocabulario contextual, busca la palabra que encaje tanto por significado como por colocación con el sustantivo y la situación.

questions.text: "We've all been (50)___________ that eight glasses of water per day is the magic number for everyone, but that notion is a myth."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque "have been taught" forma una estructura pasiva en present perfect: have + been + past participle.

A es incorrecta porque "teach" es la forma base y no puede ocupar aquí la posición de participio pasado después de "been".

C es incorrecta porque "teaching" es la forma -ing y tampoco completa la estructura pasiva.

TIP / RECUERDA: En "have/has been + ___", busca el past participle cuando se trata de voz pasiva.

questions.text: "The amount of water you need in a day (51)___________ on factors like body size, outdoor temperature..."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque el sujeto es singular: "The amount of water". Por eso, en simple present, el verbo necesita la terminación de tercera persona: "depends".

A es incorrecta porque "depend" no concuerda con un sujeto singular en tercera persona en simple present.

C es incorrecta porque "depending" es una forma -ing y no puede funcionar aquí como verbo principal sin una estructura auxiliar correspondiente.

TIP / RECUERDA: En preguntas de concordancia, identifica primero el verdadero sujeto del verbo.

questions.text: "...the best way to stay hydrated is simply to drink (52)___________ you're thirsty."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque "when you're thirsty" expresa el momento en que debe realizarse la acción: beber cuando se tiene sed.

A es incorrecta porque "where" introduce lugar y no un momento.

C es incorrecta porque "what" introduce una referencia a cosa o contenido, no una relación temporal.

TIP / RECUERDA: "When" = tiempo; "where" = lugar; "what" = cosa o información.

questions.text: "...water is a better choice than (53)___________ healthy options like sugary sodas or fruit juices."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque el contexto compara water con opciones que son menos saludables; por eso se necesita "less" para expresar menor grado.

B es incorrecta porque "more" invertiría la comparación y diría que las otras opciones son más saludables, contrario al sentido del texto.

C es incorrecta porque "fewer" se usa con sustantivos contables en plural, mientras que aquí se expresa una comparación de grado.

TIP / RECUERDA: Diferencia "less" y "fewer", y revisa siempre qué sentido exige la comparación.

questions.text: "...any beverage can add water (54)__________ your system."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque la colocación estándar es "add water to your system": "to" introduce el destino o receptor de lo que se añade.

A es incorrecta porque "add up" significa sumar o acumular numéricamente y no expresa el sentido fisiológico de esta oración.

B es incorrecta porque "add on" suele indicar añadir algo como extensión o complemento, no introducir una sustancia en el organismo mediante esta colocación.

TIP / RECUERDA: En

questions.text: "...the hydrating effects of water, beer, coffee and tea were (55)__________ identical."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque "nearly identical" es una combinación natural para expresar que dos resultados son casi iguales.

A es incorrecta porque "rarely" expresa frecuencia ("raramente") y no modifica adecuadamente "identical" en este contexto.

C es incorrecta porque "scarcely" expresa dificultad o grado mínimo y tampoco forma la colocación adecuada con "identical" aquí.

TIP / RECUERDA: Algunas preguntas de

questions.text: "...if you drink at a rate (56)__________ what your kidneys can excrete..."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque "beyond what your kidneys can excrete" indica una tasa que supera el límite de lo que los riñones pueden eliminar. "Beyond" expresa precisamente superación de un límite.

A es incorrecta porque "ahead" indica posición o avance, no el exceso respecto de una capacidad máxima.

B es incorrecta porque "farther" se usa principalmente para distancia y no encaja semánticamente con este límite fisiológico.

TIP / RECUERDA: En preposiciones, comprueba la relación semántica entre el complemento y la acción, no solo la traducción de la palabra.

questions.text: "...drinking too much water in a short period of time could (57)__________ to hyponatremia, or "water intoxication.""
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque "could lead to" es una estructura fija que expresa consecuencia: una situación puede conducir a otra.

B es incorrecta porque "cause to" no funciona como sustituto directo de "lead to" en esta estructura; "cause" requiere otra construcción.

C es incorrecta porque "follow to" no es la colocación estándar para expresar que una acción puede resultar en una consecuencia.

TIP / RECUERDA: Memoriza las collocations de consecuencia: "lead to", "result in", "result in + noun".

questions.text: "...it can cause brain swelling and neurological issues like seizures, coma or (58)__________ death."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque "even death" intensifica la gravedad de la secuencia "seizures, coma or even death", destacando la consecuencia extrema.

A es incorrecta porque "yet" expresa contraste o continuidad temporal y no funciona como intensificador en esta enumeración.

B es incorrecta porque "too" significa "también/demasiado" y no aporta la idea de consecuencia extrema que exige el contexto.

TIP / RECUERDA: "Even" suele introducir un elemento inesperado o extremo dentro de una escala de consecuencias.

questions.text: "One of the best things you can do is to stop (59)__________ it."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque "stop overthinking it" significa dejar de analizar o preocuparse excesivamente por algo, sentido coherente con la recomendación del texto.

B es incorrecta porque "overreacting" significa reaccionar de manera exagerada; no expresa la idea específica de pensar demasiado sobre el problema.

C es incorrecta porque "overworking" significa trabajar en exceso y no tiene relación con la conducta descrita en el contexto.

TIP / RECUERDA: En phrasal verbs y expresiones con "over-", identifica qué actividad o estado se está exagerando.

questions.text: "(60)____________, the best advice for staying hydrated is also the simplest: Drink when you're thirsty."
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque "instead" introduce una alternativa o recomendación que sustituye la idea anterior y conduce a la conclusión "Drink when you're thirsty".

A es incorrecta porque "as well" añade una idea ("también") y no marca la relación de sustitución que necesita el cierre.

C es incorrecta porque "although" introduce una concesión subordinada, mientras que aquí se necesita un marcador discursivo que presente una alternativa o conclusión práctica.

TIP / RECUERDA: En

questions.text: Fernanda is a student that has physical disability and uses a wheelchair to move around. She is going to enroll in a new school next week. Therefore, the classroom teacher organizes an assembly to raise awareness of Fernanda's condition. During the assembly, three students are discussing the different ways in which they can help Fernanda move around the school. Which of the following students' comments is aligned to the Approach to Inclusive Education of the National Curriculum for Basic Education?
options: To move Fernanda around, we have to take her in her wheelchair so that she can go with us wherever we go. In that way, we will help her move around the school and she will always be with a classmate by her side.
If we want to help Fernanda move around the school, we'd better ask her when she requires our help. I believe she could give us some guidance on what the best way to help her is.

I consider it will be a good idea to keep an eye on Fernanda to help her move around whenever she wants to. For that reason, I think we should take turns to take care of her in order to prevent her from having an accident at school.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... El enfoque de Educación Inclusiva del Currículo Nacional promueve el respeto a la autonomía y dignidad de las personas con discapacidad. Reconoce a Fernanda como sujeto activo de su propio proceso, consultándole directamente cómo desea ser ayudada. A es incorrecta porque... cae en el paternalismo al asumir decisiones por ella sin consultarla, tratándola como pasiva. C es incorrecta porque... también es paternalista porque propone vigilancia constante ('keep an eye on Fernanda'), lo que contradice el principio de autonomía y participación activa que sustenta la educación inclusiva.

questions.text: As part of the project 'I take care of my community,' the students have identified different problems that affect the public places around. One of the problems identified is that the neighbors are not able to use the soccer field of the community due to its deterioration. The teacher wants the students to work on this problem taking into account the Human Rights-Based Approach of the National Curriculum for Basic Education. Which of the following strategies is more appropriate to carry out?
options: Tell the students to ask the neighbors what complaints they have regarding the condition of the soccer field. Then ask the students to organize the information they got. Next, ask them to write a letter addressed to the major of the district in order for him to find a solution to the neighbors' complaints.

Discuss with the students the limitations that not being able to use the soccer field causes in their lives and in their neighbors' lives. Then ask the students whether or not it is necessary to take action to face this problem. Based on that, tell the students to propose solutions to improve the condition of the soccer field.

Ask the students to be part of a plenary session to talk about the improvements the soccer field requires so that it can be used by the neighbors. Then tell the students what actions have been taken in other communities to solve a similar problem. Finally, ask the students to choose the best action to be replicated in their community.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... El Enfoque de Derechos Humanos en el CNEB busca que los estudiantes reconozcan sus derechos y se empoderen para exigirlos y defenderlos. Parte de la vivencia personal de los estudiantes y los lleva a reflexionar críticamente sobre las limitaciones que genera la falta de acceso al campo deportivo, proponiendo ellos mismos soluciones. A es incorrecta porque... delega la solución en una autoridad externa (el alcalde) sin empoderar a los estudiantes ni promover su protagonismo. C es incorrecta porque... les da una solución prefabricada desde fuera, limitando su capacidad de análisis y propuesta propia, lo que no desarrolla el pensamiento crítico ni el empoderamiento.

questions.text: Brenda has asked the students to describe the furniture in their favorite room at home. After giving the instructions for the activity, one student asks, 'What does furniture mean?' and Brenda answers, 'Oh, tables and chairs are pieces of furniture.' Which strategy for scaffolding students' understanding has Brenda used?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... El andamiaje (scaffolding) es un proceso auxiliar del aprendizaje que consiste en ofrecer apoyos temporales para facilitar la comprensión. Brenda proporciona ejemplos concretos ('tables and chairs') para clarificar el significado de 'furniture'. A es incorrecta porque... (Chunking) implica dividir información en partes manejables para facilitar su procesamiento, no dar ejemplos de significado. B es incorrecta porque... (Modeling) implica mostrar cómo realizar una tarea completa paso a paso, no simplemente ilustrar el significado de una palabra con ejemplos aislados.

questions.text: Harold wants the students in his class to improve their cohesion in a written text through the use of discourse markers. With that purpose in mind, he asks the students to write a text about local food. Which of the following writing tasks will better help the students practice the use of discourse markers?
options: A brief article about the importance of consuming local food. The students have to include convincing information to motivate readers to eat local food.
A list of the five most popular local food in the students' community. The students have to include brief descriptions of the meals so that everyone gets to know them.
A poster encouraging people to consume local food more often. The students have to include catchy phrases and interesting pictures to attract the audience's attention.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... Los marcadores discursivos (discourse markers) se usan para conectar ideas, argumentar, contrastar y organizar el discurso de manera cohesiva. Un artículo breve que busca convencer requiere necesariamente el uso de conectores para estructurar argumentos (however, furthermore, therefore, etc.). B es incorrecta porque... (lista con descripciones) no demanda el uso sistemático de marcadores discursivos, ya que las descripciones pueden presentarse como ítems independientes. C es incorrecta porque... (póster con frases llamativas) prioriza el impacto visual y slogans breves, donde los marcadores discursivos no son el recurso principal ni necesario.

questions.text: Dario wants his third-grade students to describe past events using the simple past tense, so he has planned a lesson using the Inductive Approach. Which of the following strategies is most appropriate to carry out?
options: The teacher tells the students a well-known fairy tale emphasizing the past events of the characters. After that, the teacher asks the students to identify the tense used to narrate those past events. Finally, the teacher asks the students to retell the story using their own words.

The teacher talks about the activities he did for fun when he was a child. Then, on the board, he writes some sentences describing the activities he mentioned, in simple past tense. Finally, with the help of the students, the teacher identifies and analyzes the structure used in those sentences.

The teacher asks the students to read a singer's biography and underline five sentences in simple past tense. Next, the students share the underlined sentences aloud and the teacher corrects if necessary. Finally, with the help of the teacher, the students analyze the form of those sentences and write their own biography using the same structure.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... El enfoque inductivo requiere que los estudiantes descubran la regla gramatical a partir de la exposición a ejemplos auténticos en contexto, para luego aplicarla en una producción propia. Sigue esta secuencia: exposición a ejemplos en contexto (biografía), identificación de patrones por parte del estudiante, análisis guiado y aplicación creativa (escribir su propia biografía). A es incorrecta porque... es más narrativa que inductiva gramaticalmente, ya que el foco está en el cuento, no en el descubrimiento de la estructura. B es incorrecta porque... es parcialmente inductiva pero el docente proporciona las oraciones ya formuladas, limitando el descubrimiento autónomo por parte del estudiante. TIP / RECUERDA: Inductive Approach = examples → noticing → guided analysis → application; no comienza con la regla explícita.

questions.text: Jaime has told the students to imagine they have to talk to a friend who is having trouble. Based on that situation, they have to create and practice a dialogue. He wrote the following expressions on the board so that they can include them in their dialogues: • It'll turn out all right. • There's no need to worry. • I'm always there for you. • Take it easy. Which of the following language functions promotes the use of the expressions provided?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... Las expresiones 'It'll turn out all right', 'There's no need to worry', 'I'm always there for you' y 'Take it easy' tienen como propósito tranquilizar, infundir calma y dar seguridad emocional a alguien angustiado, lo cual corresponde a la función de reassuring someone. B es incorrecta porque... (Expressing concern) implicaría frases como 'I'm so sorry to hear that' o 'That must be tough for you', que muestran empatía pero no necesariamente tranquilizan. C es incorrecta porque... (Giving advice) implicaría sugerencias de acción como 'You should talk to someone' o 'Why don't you try relaxing?', orientadas a resolver el problema, no a calmar emocionalmente.

questions.text:
Cesar's third-grade students have been talking about the best travel destinations. Now, he wants them to use language related to that topic in an oral communicative activity. He has thought of the three following strategies:

Strategy 1: Ask the students to get in pairs and talk about a place they have visited and that they have enjoyed. Invite some students to share their classmates' answers with the rest of the class.

Strategy 2: Ask the students to give an oral presentation on the best places to go on vacation. After the students finish their presentation, the audience asks a couple of questions and the presenter replies those questions.

Strategy 3: Ask the students to play the roles of a tourist that has just visited Peru and a school newspaper journalist. The journalist asks the tourist what the best places in Peru are and the tourist replies and gives reasons for his choices.

Which of the strategies Cesar has thought of is least communicative?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... La opción B (Strategy 2) es la menos comunicativa porque, aunque la presentación oral tiene valor, el flujo de información es predominantemente unidireccional (del presentador a la audiencia) y la interacción se limita a un par de preguntas al final. A es incorrecta porque... La Strategy 1 implica intercambio de información personal entre pares con un propósito comunicativo real. C es incorrecta porque... La Strategy 3 es una simulación comunicativa con roles definidos, negociación de significado e interacción bidireccional sostenida, lo que la hace altamente comunicativa según los principios del enfoque comunicativo.

questions.text:
Marina's students are going to read a short text about the way people learn English. Here is the text:

Miriam is 6. She is from Brazil. She has just started learning English at school. She studies 3 hours a day.

Santiago is 13. He is in second grade at secondary school in Colombia. In his English class he is given a lot of grammar exercises. He thinks English is boring.

Binh is 33 and is from Vietnam. He learnt English at secondary school but has not studied it since then. He usually talks to English native speakers in order to improve his speaking skills.

Before the students read the text, Marina conducts a short survey in which the students have to write what things they have done to improve their English level.

What's Marina mainly aiming at with her survey?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... Activar los saberes previos (prior knowledge) es una estrategia pre-lectura que permite al estudiante conectar su experiencia personal con el contenido del texto, facilitando la comprensión. A es incorrecta porque... Aunque la encuesta puede tener efectos motivacionales (A), ese no es su objetivo principal. B es incorrecta porque... (Familiarizing students with the topic) es imprecisa porque el tema específico del texto es cómo diferentes personas aprenden inglés, no las actividades que los estudiantes han hecho; la encuesta activa conocimiento previo sobre estrategias de aprendizaje, no familiariza con el contenido textual específico.

questions.text: Now, Marina wants the students to practice their skimming skills, so she gives each student a copy of the text. Which of the following strategies is appropriate for Marina's purpose?
options: She asks the students to read the text quickly in order to get the general idea. Then they exchange their findings with a classmate next to them.
She asks the students to read the text carefully in order to answer some comprehension questions. Then she calls on some volunteers to share their answers aloud.
She asks the students to read the text and circle the words they are not familiar with. Then she encourages the students to get the meaning of those words by using the context.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... El skimming es una estrategia de lectura rápida cuyo objetivo es obtener la idea general (gist) de un texto sin detenerse en detalles. B es incorrecta porque... describe una lectura detallada (careful reading / intensive reading) para responder preguntas de comprensión, no skimming. C es incorrecta porque... describe una estrategia de deducción de significado de vocabulario en contexto, que corresponde a una etapa de trabajo léxico durante la lectura, no a skimming. TIP / RECUERDA: skimming busca gist; scanning busca specific information.

questions.text:
At another stage, Marina gives each student the following chart:

| Activities | People's names | |:---|:---| | Playing games in English in the classroom | | | Using websites to search information | | | Using free mobile apps | | | Doing communicative tasks | | | Reading books or magazines in English | | | Watching movies in English | |

Then she gives her students the following instructions: 'Read the text again, and based on the information, decide which activity is best for each of the people presented in the text. Write the person's name next to each activity.'

Which reading skill is NOT promoted in the activity above?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... La actividad requiere que los estudiantes busquen información específica en el texto (scanning) y relacionen datos implícitos para asignar actividades a personas (inferring). Sin embargo, no hay ningún elemento en la consigna que exija ordenar secuencialmente eventos, pasos o información, por lo que el skill de ordering no se promueve. B es incorrecta porque... (Scanning) sí se promueve al buscar qué actividad corresponde a cada persona. C es incorrecta porque... (Inferring) se promueve porque el texto no dice explícitamente 'Miriam juega juegos en inglés', sino que el estudiante debe inferirlo a partir de la edad y contexto.

questions.text:
In the next activity, Marina groups the students and asks them to answer the following questions: • Is a person's age relevant to learn English? Explain. • What advice would you give the people in the text to learn English in a fun way?

Which reading skill are the students in Marina's class working on?
options: Reflecting on the content of the text.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... Las preguntas exigen que los estudiantes vayan más allá de la información explícita del texto para emitir juicios personales, evaluar la relevancia de la edad y proponer consejos, lo cual constituye reflexión crítica sobre el contenido. A es incorrecta porque... (Contextualizing information) requeriría ubicar la información en un contexto histórico, social o cultural más amplio, no necesariamente evaluarla ni dar opiniones personales. C es incorrecta porque... (Retrieving information) implicaría solo extraer datos explícitos del texto, sin emitir juicio propio.

questions.text:
Diana wants her fifth-grade students to develop stronger argumentation skills through a class discussion on the question 'Are schools better or worse than thirty years ago?' With that purpose in mind, she has planned the following sequence:

• First, on the board, the teacher writes the question 'Are schools better or worse than thirty years ago?' and sticks pictures that depict schools now and then. • Next, she writes a sentence comparing the schools and asks the students to think about other possible comparisons. • She pairs up the students and asks them to discuss the sentences they came up with for some minutes. • When the students finish discussing, she calls on some volunteers to write one of their sentences on the board. • As a whole class, the teacher asks the students to select the sentences they agree on and explain the reasons of their choice. • After that, the teacher encourages the students to take a stance based on their own point of view. • Then the teacher tells the students they have some minutes to write their arguments according to the stance taken.

Which of the following activities is more appropriate to assign the students as homework in order to help them develop stronger argumentation skills?
options: Ask the students to rehearse presenting their arguments in order to gain confidence and fluency.
Ask the students to add extra arguments so that their ideas are more interesting and convincing.
Ask the students to look for evidence included in different sources of information and add it to their arguments.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... Una argumentación sólida requiere evidencia verificable y fuentes confiables que sustenten las posturas. Buscar evidencia en diferentes fuentes fortalece la validez de los argumentos y desarrolla el pensamiento crítico. A es incorrecta porque... se centra en la fluidez oral y la confianza en la presentación, no en la fortaleza argumentativa como tal. B es incorrecta porque... sugiere añadir más argumentos sin garantizar que estén sustentados, lo que puede generar argumentos débiles, redundantes o basados solo en opinión personal sin respaldo.

questions.text:
Consuelo's students are going to be speakers in their science school fair. She provides the students with the following expressions to be used during the event: • As you probably know, there have been... • Turning to... • You may be aware of... • Now, we'll move on to...

Which of the following language functions DOES NOT correspond to the expressions presented above?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... Ninguna de las expresiones presentadas cumple la función de summarizing. 'As you probably know' y 'You may be aware of' proporcionan antecedentes o contexto (providing background), mientras que 'Turning to' y 'Now, we'll move on to' indican cambio de tema (changing the topic). A es incorrecta porque... sí corresponde a providing background; por tanto, no es la función que NO corresponde. C es incorrecta porque... sí corresponde a changing the topic; por tanto, tampoco es la función que NO corresponde.

questions.text:
Manuela has asked the students in her class to role-play a situation in pairs. When Sheila and Joaquin are performing the role-play, Joaquin makes a grammar mistake, but Sheila understands what he means and continues with the activity.

Which of the following actions is NOT appropriate to carry out after the role-play?
options: Repeat Joaquin's sentence emphasizing the mistake and encourage him to say the correct form.
Give Joaquin a note including the mistake and its correct form so that he can be aware of the mistake.
Make a comment pointing out Joaquin's mistake, correct it and tell him to write a sentence using that form.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... interrumpe el proceso comunicativo al señalar el error de manera directa y exigir una producción escrita inmediata después de una actividad oral, lo que puede generar inhibición y ansiedad. En una evaluación o actividad comunicativa de expresión oral, la retroalimentación debe ser oportuna y respetuosa, sin interrumpir el flujo comunicativo. A es incorrecta porque... utiliza una forma de recasting (reformulación implícita) al repetir la oración enfatizando el error para que Joaquin se autocorrija, lo cual es válido. B es incorrecta porque... ofrece retroalimentación privada y diferida, también coherente con el enfoque comunicativo. TIP / RECUERDA: en speaking comunicativo, la retroalimentación debe atender la forma sin interrumpir innecesariamente la comunicación.

questions.text:
Gabriela's students are going to write an essay about the effects of online education on students. Here are some of the steps she will follow throughout her writing lesson.

Before the students start writing their essays, Gabriela wants them to discuss what they usually do during the planning stage. She asks the students the following question: 'What activities do you carry out to plan a text?' Here are some of the students' answers to her question:

Mario says: 'I usually write a list of key words or ideas about the topic because they help me write the text better.'

Noelia says: 'In my case, I look for websites or books that have reliable information about the topic I have to write about.'

Oscar says: 'I prefer looking for a good sample of the text and then write something similar to it.'

Which student's comment is NOT aligned to the actions done during the planning stage?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... buscar una muestra para imitarla no es una acción propia de la planificación en process writing; la planificación se centra en generar, seleccionar y organizar ideas y fuentes. A es incorrecta porque... elaborar una lista de palabras clave o ideas es brainstorming, una estrategia de planificación. B es incorrecta porque... buscar información confiable en sitios web o libros puede formar parte de la planificación y preparación del contenido.

questions.text: Once the students have finished planning their texts, Gabriela wants to give them some recommendations to write their first draft. Which of the following set of recommendations is appropriate to give at this stage of the writing process?
options: 'Choose the most important ideas from your plan to be used as main ideas in each paragraph of your text. Then try to add supporting sentences and examples in each paragraph.'
'Use all of the ideas from your plan to develop the texts of the essay. Use as many linking words as possible to connect your ideas in each paragraph and throughout the whole essay.'
'Organize the information from the planning stage into sections. Pay attention to the grammar structures in each paragraph and check punctuation.'
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... En el primer borrador (first draft), el enfoque debe estar en la organización de ideas principales y el desarrollo de párrafos con oraciones de soporte y ejemplos. B es incorrecta porque... 'usar todas las ideas' puede generar desorganización y 'usar tantos conectores como sea posible' produce sobrecarga mecánica y artificial. C es incorrecta porque... corresponde a etapas de revisión posteriores, no al primer borrador, donde lo prioritario es el contenido y la estructura, no la corrección gramatical detallada ni la división en secciones formales. TIP / RECUERDA: first draft prioriza contenido y organización; la corrección detallada se trabaja en revisión.

questions.text: When the students finish writing the first version of their texts, Gabriela asks them to exchange their text with a peer in order to revise it. Which of the following aspects should be a focus of this first revision?
options: Appropriate extension and organization of the paragraphs.
Use of varied words and accurate grammar structures.
Understanding and delivery of the message.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... en la primera revisión entre pares (peer review) del primer borrador, lo fundamental es comprobar si el mensaje se comprende y cumple con el propósito comunicativo. A es incorrecta porque... la extensión y organización de los párrafos pueden refinarse después de comprobar que el mensaje es claro. B es incorrecta porque... la precisión gramatical y léxica se trabaja con mayor detalle en revisiones posteriores, una vez asegurada la claridad del mensaje.

questions.text: After the students have finished writing their essay, Gabriela wants them to reflect on the writing process they have gone through. Which of the following activities is least appropriate to carry out?
options: The teacher sticks, on the board, a flipchart that shows the steps to write a text. She encourages the students to say aloud whether or not each of the steps was followed during their writing activity.

The teacher asks the students to mention the steps they have followed during the writing process. From the steps mentioned, the students choose which step was the easiest or the most challenging and support their ideas in spoken English.

The teacher draws, on the board, three faces with different expressions: happy, sad and confused. She asks the students to choose the face that shows how they feel after having gone through the writing process and explain their choice orally.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... comprobar mecánicamente si se siguieron los pasos no promueve por sí mismo una reflexión personal sobre las decisiones, dificultades y aprendizajes del proceso de escritura. B es incorrecta porque... pide identificar el paso más fácil o desafiante y justificarlo, lo que sí favorece la metacognición. C es incorrecta porque... permite expresar y explicar cómo se sintieron durante el proceso, generando una reflexión sobre la experiencia. TIP / RECUERDA: metacognition implica analizar el propio proceso, las decisiones y las dificultades.

questions.text:
Keyla wants to help her fourth-grade students develop their listening skills. With that purpose in mind, she has brought the audio of a radio interview with a famous actress. Here is the transcript of the audio she will play:

Interviewer: Hi, everyone. I'm Marcos Osorio. Joining me this evening is the recent winner of the Silver Drama award, Stephanie Smith. Good evening, Stephanie. Welcome to the show.

Stephanie: Good evening, Marcos and everyone. I haven't been to a radio show for ages, so it's a pleasure to be here with you.

Interviewer: The pleasure is all mine, Stephanie. Tell us what you are up to these days.

Stephanie: For the past six months, I've been working non-stop for my upcoming movie, so I've been really busy.

Interviewer: I know! This is quite a departure for you, isn't it? You've been a theater performer since 2010, and now you're starring a movie for the first time. What about this new experience?

Stephanie: It's a wonderful experience! Working in different sets, traveling a lot and sharing so much time with experienced actors is awesome. I'm really satisfied.

Interviewer: If you had to choose between movies or theater, which one would you choose?

Stephanie: That's a very difficult question! I guess, if I had to choose one, it would be theater.

Interviewer: And when is the movie going to be released?

Stephanie: Pretty soon! In December, so you'd better be ready...

First, Keyla wants her students to get the gist of the audio. Which of the following listening activities is it more appropriate to carry out?
options: Ask the students to listen to the audio and find out how Stephanie feels about her first movie. Then ask the students to compare their answers in pairs.
Ask the students to listen to the audio and identify what the interview is about. Then tell the students to compare their answers with a classmate next to them.
Ask the students to listen to the audio and infer the mood of the interviewer and the actress during the interview. Then ask some students to share their answers aloud.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... El gist es la idea general de un texto oral. Identificar de qué trata la entrevista ('what the interview is about') es precisamente una tarea de listening for gist. A es incorrecta porque... se enfoca en un detalle específico (sentimientos sobre una película), lo cual corresponde a listening for specific information o inferencia, no gist. C es incorrecta porque... requiere inferir el estado de ánimo, una habilidad de mayor demanda cognitiva que no corresponde al nivel de comprensión general.

questions.text: Now, Keyla wants her students to develop their listening skill 'Inferring information.' Which of the following questions is it more appropriate to ask in order to achieve Keyla's purpose?
options: How does Stephanie feel about acting?
How experienced is Stephanie at acting?
How long has Stephanie worked non-stop?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... Inferir información requiere interpretar lo que se dice entre líneas. La pregunta sobre cómo se siente Stephanie respecto a la actuación exige interpretar su tono, elección de palabras ('wonderful experience', 'awesome', 'satisfied') y actitud general, no solo localizar datos explícitos. B es incorrecta porque... puede responderse con información explícita ('theater performer since 2010'). C es incorrecta porque... es un dato explícito ('for the past six months'). TIP / RECUERDA: inferir es deducir lo no explícito a partir de pistas del texto oral.

questions.text:
