Here is a fragment of the radio interview:

Interviewer: If you had to choose between movies or theater, which one would you choose?

Stephanie: That's a very difficult question! I guess, if I had to choose one, it would be theater.

Which of the following language functions is used in the fragment above?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... , aunque aparece una estructura condicional, el intercambio completo busca expresar la elección personal de Stephanie entre movies y theater; la función comunicativa es expressing preferences. B es incorrecta porque... no se solicita ni se ofrece consejo; se trata de una elección personal. C es incorrecta porque... la estructura condicional es un recurso gramatical, pero la función comunicativa principal no es especular, sino expresar una preferencia.

questions.text:
The students in Andrea's class are working on the text 'The future of technology.' During one of the activities, Andrea notices that some students are having difficulty understanding the meaning of some words from the text. As a consequence, those students are taking longer to finish the activities planned.

What should Andrea do to prevent this situation from happening again?
options: Letting students use a bilingual dictionary.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... el pre-teaching vocabulary es una estrategia de andamiaje que activa el conocimiento previo del léxico clave antes de la lectura, facilitando la comprensión del texto y evitando que los estudiantes se estanquen. A es incorrecta porque... (permitir diccionario bilingüe) puede distraer del flujo lector, fomentar la traducción palabra por palabra y no desarrollar estrategias de comprensión de texto. C es incorrecta porque... (dar más tiempo) es una medida paliativa que no resuelve la causa raíz del problema: la falta de comprensión léxica, y no promueve el aprendizaje a largo plazo.

questions.text:
Josue has asked his fourth-grade students to bring some items to sell at the classroom market. He has planned the following speaking activity:

At the classroom market • The students will move around the classroom trying to sell their items; they will discuss on the conditions of sale: 'How much...?', 'How many...?' • They will also use language such as 'How about...?', 'Could you make that...?', 'Why don't you...?', and expressions such as 'That's a deal', 'No deal', etc. • Finally, the students will report to the class what they bought, what they sold or could not sell.

What are the two language functions involved in this speaking activity?
options: Talking about prices and quantities / Using expressions to negotiate.
Requesting services / Asking and answering in a polite way.
Getting to know likes and dislikes / Requesting deeper information.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... Las expresiones 'How much...?' y 'How many...?' corresponden a la función de hablar sobre precios y cantidades. Las expresiones 'How about...?', 'Could you make that...?', 'That's a deal', 'No deal' son fórmulas típicas de negociación en un contexto de compra-venta. B es incorrecta porque... no corresponde porque no se solicitan servicios, sino productos, y la cortesía no es la función principal. C es incorrecta porque... no se busca conocer gustos ni solicitar información profunda, sino concretar transaciones comerciales.

questions.text:
Marcia wants to involve her students in intensive listening tasks. She will use a short video recipe on how to make spaghetti. She has thought of the following listening tasks:

Task 1: Tell the students to choose the moment from the video they like the most. Ask them to explain the reasons of their choice.

Task 2: Ask the students to take notes of the ingredients shown in the video. Tell them to include the amounts used to prepare the recipe, too.

Task 3: Ask the students to give an opinion about the recipe on the video. Ask them to mention if the recipe was easy or difficult and if they would like to prepare it.

Which of the listening tasks above is appropriate to achieve the teacher's purpose?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... intensive listening exige atención detallada al input oral; identificar y anotar ingredientes y cantidades requiere localizar información específica con precisión. A es incorrecta porque... elegir un momento favorito y justificarlo es una reacción personal, no una tarea de comprensión detallada. C es incorrecta porque... expresar una opinión sobre la receta no exige procesar minuciosamente la información del audio.

questions.text:
Rafael wanted to plan a communicative speaking assessment for his third-grade students. Since his students have been talking about the weather, he has decided to evaluate them through the following game-like activity: Divide the class into groups of four. Each group gets a dice. In each of the dice's faces, there is a word related to the weather (cloudy, windy, snowy, etc.). The students take turns to throw the dice and say a sentence using the word they got (e.g. 'Today is cloudy').

Given Rafael's goal of designing a communicative speaking assessment, which of the following criticisms of this activity is appropriate?
options: The activity provides limited speaking practice.
Game-like activities may not be used for speaking evaluation.
Students do not have enough vocabulary to build complete sentences.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... Aunque la actividad lúdica motiva, para ser una evaluación comunicativa de expresión oral debe promover la interacción genuina, la negociación de significado y el uso funcional del lenguaje. Esta actividad limita la práctica oral a oraciones aisladas y descontextualizadas, sin interlocutor real ni propósito comunicativo más allá de nombrar el clima. B es incorrecta porque... las actividades lúdicas sí pueden usarse en evaluación si están bien diseñadas. C es incorrecta porque... el ejemplo muestra que los estudiantes sí pueden formar oraciones con el vocabulario dado.

questions.text:
Carmelo's students have been talking about activities they used to do when they were younger, but they don't do anymore. Now, he wants them to participate in a discussion related to that topic using some of the following expressions: • I wouldn't want to do that again. • That's a load off my mind. • Phew! Thank goodness!

Which of the following language functions is Carmelo trying to promote?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... Las tres expresiones comunican alivio por no tener que repetir una experiencia pasada. 'That's a load off my mind' significa literalmente 'eso me quita un peso de encima'. 'Phew! Thank goodness!' es una exclamación de alivio. A es incorrecta porque... (Expressing disappointment) implicaría tristeza por algo que no ocurrió o no se logró. B es incorrecta porque... (Expressing annoyance) implicaría enojo o irritación activa, no el sentimiento de liberación que expresan estas frases.

questions.text: Patricia wants the students in her class to get familiar with the topic of daily routines using the Lexical Approach. Which of the following strategies is it appropriate to carry out?
options: The teacher gives each student a worksheet containing sentences that describe people's daily routines. Each sentence has a gap that should be filled in with a verb. Then the students fill in the gaps.

The teacher hands out each student an infographic that contains a famous person's routine. She asks them to read and identify collocations such as 'take a shower,' 'have breakfast,' etc. Then the students use those collocations to describe their own daily routines.

The teacher reads the students the story 'A day in my life.' The story describes the teacher's daily routine. As she reads the story, she asks the students to raise their hands every time they hear an expression or phrase that describes a daily activity they do.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... El Lexical Approach postula que el lenguaje se aprende en chunks o combinaciones léxicas (collocations, expresiones prefabricadas) más que en estructuras gramaticales aisladas. La opción B trabaja directamente con colocaciones ('take a shower', 'have breakfast') y las aplica a contextos personales, favoreciendo la retención y el uso natural. A es incorrecta porque... se centra en la gramática (verbos en espacios en blanco), no en chunks léxicos. C es incorrecta porque... es una actividad de reconocimiento pasivo que no prioriza el uso productivo de chunks léxicos ni su aplicación personal. TIP / RECUERDA: Lexical Approach = chunks y collocations, no solo palabras aisladas o reglas.

questions.text: Marcos has noticed that the English level of one of his students, Federico, is way higher than the rest of the class. As a result, he finishes all the writing tasks too soon and, of course, they are flawless. How should Marcos handle Federico's case?
options: He can tell Federico to remain in silence and allow him to do something else.
He can plan a more challenging version of the writing tasks for Federico.
He can appoint Federico as secretary and let him assess his classmates' texts.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... responde al principio de atención a la diversidad y diferenciación pedagógica. Un estudiante con nivel superior requiere mayores demandas cognitivas para continuar su desarrollo. A es incorrecta porque... desperdicia el potencial del estudiante y puede generar desmotivación. C es incorrecta porque... , aunque podría tener algún valor formativo, convierte al estudiante en evaluador de sus pares sin formación para ello, lo que puede generar conflictos, injusticias y no garantiza su propio aprendizaje ni su desarrollo continuo.

questions.text: Eulogio wants his third-grade students to infer information from the audio of a story. Which of the following activities develops that skill appropriately?
options: Ask the students to pay attention to the expressions the characters used in the story. Encourage the students to say if the characters know each other and explain why.
Ask the students to take notes on the most important ideas included in the story. Encourage the students to write a summary including that information.
Ask the students to choose the moment from the story they liked or didn't like the most. Encourage the students to support their ideas.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... Inferir implica deducir información no explícita a partir de pistas lingüísticas o paraverbales. Deducir si los personajes se conocen a partir de sus expresiones requiere interpretar relaciones sociales implícitas, lo cual es una inferencia genuina. B es incorrecta porque... es una actividad de identificación de ideas principales y elaboración de un resumen (summary), que opera sobre información explícita. C es incorrecta porque... es una reacción personal que no requiere necesariamente inferencia del texto, sino preferencia subjetiva.

questions.text: Vanessa's students are going to read a text titled 'How to help your community' and she wants to set a pre-reading task. In order to achieve this goal, which of the following tasks is appropriate?
options: Have a discussion about the text.
Read the title, and predict the content of the text.
Scan new idiomatic expressions shown in the text.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... Una tarea pre-lectura (pre-reading) apropiada activa el conocimiento previo y genera expectativas. Predecir a partir del título es una estrategia clásica de pre-lectura que prepara al lector cognitivamente. A es incorrecta porque... ('have a discussion about the text') es imprecisa porque aún no se ha leído el texto; no se puede discutir sobre algo que no se conoce. C es incorrecta porque... (scanning de expresiones idiomáticas) corresponde a una actividad durante la lectura (while-reading), no antes, y además asume que el estudiante ya tiene acceso al texto. TIP / RECUERDA: pre-reading prepara y anticipa; while-reading procesa el texto; post-reading permite responder o producir a partir de él.

questions.text:
Camilo's students are going to listen to a short audio about candidates applying for different jobs. Before the students listen to the audio, the teacher does the following activities: • First, the teacher shows the students flashcards of jobs and elicits the job titles. • Next, the teacher pairs up the students and asks them to discuss what qualities are needed for those jobs. • Then the teacher calls for volunteers to share their answers with the class. • Finally, the teacher tells the students they will listen to an audio related to jobs.

Based on the activities presented, which stage of the lesson is Camilo developing?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... El lead-in es la etapa inicial de una sesión de comprensión oral cuyo objetivo es activar el conocimiento previo, generar interés y preparar el contexto temático y léxico antes de exponer al estudiante al texto oral. Las actividades descritas (flashcards, discusión de cualidades, predicción) son características de esta fase. B es incorrecta porque... (Presentation) implica la introducción de nueva lengua o estructuras gramaticales. C es incorrecta porque... (Controlled practice) ocurre después de la exposición al input, cuando los estudiantes practican la nueva lengua en ejercicios guiados.

questions.text: Mario wants his fourth-grade students to do free writing about the topic 'Past experiences.' Which of the following activities is it appropriate to carry out?
options: Ask the students to write 'past experiences' in the center of a piece of paper and add some ideas surrounding the phrase. Tell the students to think of new ideas that relate to the ideas previously written.
Ask the students to write, in their notebooks, the following questions: Who? What? Where? When? Why? And How? Tell the students to think about a past experience and answer those questions.
Ask the students to write some sentences about any past experience that comes to mind. Tell the students that they have to write as much as they can for ten minutes.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... El free writing (escritura libre) es una técnica de generación de ideas donde el estudiante escribe de forma continua y espontánea durante un tiempo limitado, sin preocuparse por la corrección gramatical. A es incorrecta porque... describe un mapa mental (clustering), que es una técnica de planificación previa a la escritura, no escritura libre propiamente dicha. B es incorrecta porque... describe un cuestionamiento guiado, que restringe la libertad creativa y la espontaneidad propias del free writing.

questions.text: Junior's students are going to read a text about technology. Before the students start reading the text, he wants to give an appropriate instruction for the first reading. What instruction should be given?
options: 'Focus on what kind of verbs are used.'
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... la primera lectura debe orientarse a captar la main idea o gist del texto. B es incorrecta porque... centra la atención en una característica gramatical específica, no en la comprensión global. C es incorrecta porque... dirige la atención hacia expresiones léxicas nuevas y requiere un procesamiento más detallado.

questions.text:
Florencia wants her fourth-grade students to develop their listening skills using a radio spot in English of the Pan American and Parapan American Games 2019. With that purpose in mind, she has designed different activities.

Before listening to the radio spot, Florencia wants to activate her students' prior knowledge on the topic in a communicative way. Which of the following strategies is it appropriate to carry out?
options: Bring a word search puzzle with some words related to the Pan American and Parapan American Games. Give the students some minutes to find the words in the word search puzzle. Finally, ask the students to get in pairs and compare the words they found.

Give each student a worksheet with a matching exercise about the Pan American and Parapan American Games. The exercise has two columns with phrases under each column. Tell the students to choose one phrase from each column and connect them in order to make a sentence.

Write the title 'Pan American and Parapan American Games 2019' on the board. Provide the students with prompts such as: 'I think that...', 'Some sports played at this event are...', etc. Ask the students to stand up, find a peer and start a dialogue about the games using the prompts provided.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... Activar conocimientos previos de manera comunicativa implica que los estudiantes usen el lenguaje oral de forma interactiva e interpersonal. La estrategia C promueve el diálogo espontáneo entre pares con guías lingüísticas, cumpliendo con el criterio comunicativo. A es incorrecta porque... es una actividad individual y mecánica (sopa de letras) que no promueve la comunicación genuina. B es incorrecta porque... (matching exercise) también es mecánica y se centra en la forma gramatical de armar oraciones, no en el intercambio comunicativo de ideas.

questions.text:
Florencia asks her students to listen to the following radio spot: 'The Pan American and Parapan American Games are about to start. There will be athletes from different countries such as USA, Brazil, Mexico, Canada, Cuba, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Venezuela, Jamaica and some others. Don't miss this opportunity to see sports like basketball, handball, bowling, boxing, badminton, baseball and many more. Look for information about venues, ticket prices, dates and schedules at Lima2019.pe!'

Then she asks the students to come up with a phrase or sentence that expresses what the audio is about. Which of the following listening skills is being developed through this activity?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... Pedir una frase que exprese de qué trata el audio es una tarea clásica de listening for gist (idea general). B es incorrecta porque... (Predicting content) ocurre antes de escuchar, no después, como preparación. C es incorrecta porque... (Listening for details) implicaría preguntar por información específica como nombres de países, deportes o precios, no por una síntesis general del contenido.

questions.text: Now, the students listen to the radio spot again and write down the sports mentioned in the audio. Which of the following listening skills is being developed through this activity?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... Identificar y anotar los deportes mencionados es una tarea de listening for specific information (scanning auditivo), donde el estudiante busca datos concretos en el flujo del habla. A es incorrecta porque... (Paraphrasing) implicaría reformular la información con otras palabras, no transcribirla literalmente. B es incorrecta porque... (Detecting connectors) es una habilidad diferente que no se solicita en la consigna ni es necesaria para completar la tarea.

questions.text: Next, the teacher wants her students to work on a post-listening task to develop their speaking skills. Which of the following tasks is appropriate to achieve the teacher's purpose?
options: Ask the students to record their own radio spot for a sports event in their community. Tell them to include some features of the spot they have just listened to such as speaker's intonation and adjectives. Encourage the students to add other relevant information like prices, locations, schedules, etc.

Play the radio spot again and ask the students to write as much information as possible in their notebooks. Tell them to use their notes to write a new version of the spot but using their own words. Invite some volunteers to read their own versions of the spot aloud.

Give each student a worksheet that contains the radio spot with some blanks in it. Ask the students to listen carefully and fill in the blanks with the appropriate words. Pair up the students and ask them to compare their answers for some minutes.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... Una tarea post-escucha (post-listening) que desarrolle la expresión oral debe transferir lo escuchado a una producción oral creativa y contextualizada. Grabar un spot de radio propio permite practicar la fluidez, la entonación y el uso de vocabulario en un contexto comunicativo real. B es incorrecta porque... se centra en escritura (reading aloud no es producción oral genuina ni desarrollo de habilidades expresivas). C es incorrecta porque... es una actividad de comprensión auditiva (gap-filling), no de expresión oral.

questions.text:
Read the following teaching sequence and answer the question: • The students look at some flashcards with vocabulary they will use later in the activity. • The teacher gives a short dialogue to the students for them to read. • Next, the teacher asks them to repeat the dialogue twice after him/her. • Finally, the students read aloud the conversation in pairs.

Why is this teaching sequence inappropriate to develop speaking?
options: It does not have a presentation stage.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... El desarrollo de la expresión oral requiere una secuencia que incluya presentación, práctica controlada y producción libre (PPP), donde el estudiante pueda usar el lenguaje de forma creativa y personalizada. La secuencia descrita se queda en la lectura y repetición mecánica (drilling), sin llegar a una etapa de producción donde los estudiantes generen sus propios mensajes. A es incorrecta porque... más práctica de pronunciación no resuelve la falta de producción comunicativa. B es incorrecta porque... sí hay presentación (flashcards y diálogo modelo). TIP / RECUERDA: la práctica controlada debe conducir a una producción oral más libre y significativa.

questions.text: Victor wants his students to practice the speaking skill of communicating ideas fluently through the topic 'My daily routine.' Which of the following activities is most appropriate to carry out?
options: The teacher asks the students to stand up and mingle. In pairs, one student describes her daily routine and the other asks follow-up questions, then they exchange roles. The same procedure is repeated until the students have talked to at least four classmates.

The teacher asks the students to interview a classmate on everyday activities and write down the answers in their notebooks. Then they prepare a short oral report. Finally, they share the report with the rest of the class.
The teacher asks the students to make a list of the activities they do every day. Then some volunteers read their lists to the rest of the class. The audience can ask each speaker some questions.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... La fluidez oral se desarrolla mediante práctica extensiva en contextos comunicativos auténticos con múltiples interlocutores. La actividad de 'mingle' con follow-up questions obliga al estudiante a adaptarse a diferentes conversaciones, mantener el flujo y responder espontáneamente. B es incorrecta porque... incluye demasiada escritura (tomar notas y preparar reporte), lo que desvía el foco de la fluidez oral inmediata. C es incorrecta porque... se limita a lectura de listas, que es una producción oral muy controlada, monótona y sin la necesidad de adaptación lingüística real.

questions.text:
Kevin has prepared the reading material for his second-grade class which includes the fable titled 'The tortoise and the hare.' After having worked on different reading tasks, Kevin wants his students to think critically on the text.

Given this goal, which of the following questions is appropriate?
options: What is the main topic of the fable?
Where did the hare finally take a nap?
Why do you think the tortoise never gave up running?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... El pensamiento crítico en lectura requiere que el estudiante analice motivaciones, evalúe decisiones de los personajes y construya interpretaciones propias. La pregunta 'Why do you think...' exige inferencia y juicio personal, promoviendo el análisis profundo. A es incorrecta porque... es una pregunta de identificación de tema explícito o general. B es incorrecta porque... es una pregunta de localización de información explícita en el texto, de muy baja demanda cognitiva.

questions.text: Which of the following sets of strategies is the most appropriate to develop the language function 'Introducing people' through speaking?
options: • The students watch a video in which three people introduce themselves to each other. • Then the teacher asks his/her students to write down the conversation. • After seeing the video again, the students complete some related conversations in the book. • The students practice one of the conversations they completed. • Finally, the teacher calls on volunteers to present the conversations they chose to the class.

• The teacher shows a picture in the book in which people are introducing themselves to each other. • The teacher explains, on the board, that in English the structure This is + the person's name is used to introduce people. • The teacher writes a couple of examples on the board. • The students complete the blanks in conversations in a worksheet. • Finally, the teacher calls on volunteers to present the conversations to the class.

• The teacher shows flashcards of people introducing themselves to each other. • Then he/she shows them on the board a model conversation in which someone is introducing two people. • He/she asks them which expressions are used in the conversation to introduce people. • The students practice the conversation, first using gestures and exchanging roles, and then using their real names. • The teacher calls on volunteers to act out the conversation in front of the class.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... Desarrollar una función del lenguaje a través del speaking requiere secuencias que vayan desde la exposición del input, la identificación de las expresiones, la práctica controlada con gestos y cambio de roles, hasta la producción personalizada con nombres reales. A es incorrecta porque... incluye escritura y completado de diálogos del libro, lo que diluye el foco oral. B es incorrecta porque... es excesivamente deductiva (explicación de regla primero) y se centra en completar espacios en blanco, sin práctica oral significativa ni personalización real.

questions.text:
The school year is almost starting so Yola is reviewing the syllabus for the first two months. She identifies the grammar structures she will work on and associates each one to a function in the following list:

| Language function | Structure | |:---|:---| | Talking about location | Prepositions (in, on, under, next, between, at) | | Giving directions | Yes-no questions with modals (may, could, would) | | Making suggestions | Why don't we (+ base form verb), What about (+ -ing)? |

Unfortunately, she has made one mistake. Which of the structures in Yola's notes have been associated to the wrong function?
options: Prepositions (in, on, under, next, between, at).
Yes-no questions with modals (may, could, would).
Why don't we (+ base form verb), What about (+ -ing)?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... las yes-no questions con modals como 'may', 'could' y 'would' se relacionan con requests o permission, no con giving directions. A es incorrecta porque... las prepositions (in, on, under, next, between, at) sí están correctamente asociadas con talking about location. C es incorrecta porque... 'Why don't we...?' y 'What about...?' están correctamente asociadas con making suggestions.

questions.text:
Rommy's students have written a text about 'The pros and cons of social networks.' Before collecting the texts, Rommy wants her students to do a final revision focused on the three following criteria: • Criterion 1: Make sure that the vocabulary is appropriate for the readers of the text. • Criterion 2: Make sure that linking words have been used properly and whenever necessary. • Criterion 3: Make sure that the topic is well developed and the sentences support it adequately.

Rommy writes those criteria on the board. Then she asks the students to work in pairs to check each other's texts taking into account the criteria presented.

Which criterion promotes the revision of cohesion?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... los linking words conectan ideas y oraciones, por lo que su uso adecuado es un criterio directo para revisar la cohesion. A es incorrecta porque... evalúa la adecuación del vocabulario al lector, no la conexión entre ideas. C es incorrecta porque... evalúa el desarrollo del tema y el soporte de las ideas, relacionado principalmente con coherence. TIP / RECUERDA: cohesion conecta lingüísticamente las partes; coherence organiza el sentido global.

questions.text: Which criterion promotes the revision of coherence?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... comprobar si el tema está bien desarrollado y si las oraciones lo apoyan evalúa el sentido global y la organización lógica del texto, es decir, coherence. A es incorrecta porque... se centra en la adecuación del vocabulario al lector. B es incorrecta porque... los linking words son recursos de cohesion, no el criterio principal para evaluar coherence.

questions.text: Ruben's students are learning how to introduce people for the first time. Even though they still make mistakes, they seem to be really motivated. Which of the following alternatives best describes the learning stage Ruben's students have reached?
options: Unconscious incompetence: the student does not know or understand how to use the language function and does not know it exists.
Conscious competence: the student has mastered the language function and the skill appears easily while performing others.
Conscious incompetence: the student knows the language function exists (though he does not know or understand how to use it) and values it as a learning tool.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... los estudiantes reconocen la función y valoran aprenderla, pero todavía cometen errores al utilizarla; esto corresponde a conscious incompetence. A es incorrecta porque... describe a quien todavía no reconoce que necesita aprender o mejorar la habilidad. B es incorrecta porque... conscious competence supone dominio consciente de la habilidad, mientras que aquí los estudiantes todavía cometen errores. TIP / RECUERDA: conscious incompetence significa saber que se necesita aprender o mejorar una habilidad.

questions.text: I work in a (46) ______ traditional office environment doing a typical nine-to-five job.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... 'Fairly' es un adverbio de grado que significa 'bastante' o 'moderadamente' y se usa comúnmente antes de adjetivos para matizar la intensidad ('fairly traditional'). B es incorrecta porque... 'Extremely' (B) sería excesivamente enfático para el contexto neutro del texto. C es incorrecta porque... 'Constantly' (C) es un adverbio de frecuencia, no de grado, y no puede modificar un adjetivo como 'traditional'.

questions.text: ...most of my work could really be (47) ______ online from home.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... La estructura pasiva 'could be done' indica que el trabajo puede realizarse en línea. B es incorrecta porque... 'Started' (B) no tiene sentido lógico porque el trabajo no 'se inicia' en línea en este contexto. C es incorrecta porque... 'Explained' (C) no se ajusta al significado de realizar labores laborales.

questions.text: But my boss doesn't seem to trust (48) ______ we will get any work done if left to our own devices...
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... 'Trust' puede ir seguido de una cláusula sustantiva introducida por 'that' (el 'that' es opcional pero gramaticalmente correcto). A es incorrecta porque... 'Where' (A) introduce adverbios de lugar. B es incorrecta porque... 'Which' (B) introduce cláusulas relativas, no sustantivas después de 'trust' en este contexto.

questions.text: It's frustrating that they feel the need to monitor what we do so (49) ______ instead of judging us based on our task performance...
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... 'Monitor closely' es una colocación estándar que significa 'vigilar de cerca'. A es incorrecta porque... 'Nearly' (A) significa 'casi' y no encaja con 'monitor'. C es incorrecta porque... 'Promptly' (C) significa 'rápidamente' y no es la colocación adecuada para describir la intensidad de la vigilancia. TIP / RECUERDA: en

questions.text: ...we decided to cut my working week (50) ______ to a three-day work week.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... El phrasal verb 'cut down' significa 'reducir'. A es incorrecta porque... 'Cut in' (A) significa 'interrumpir'. B es incorrecta porque... 'Cut up' (B) significa 'cortar en pedazos'. TIP / RECUERDA: en phrasal verbs, la partícula puede cambiar completamente el significado.

questions.text: I've noticed, though, that my workload (51) ______ decreased in the slightest!
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... El present perfect 'hasn't decreased' conecta el pasado con el presente y se usa con 'I've noticed' (present perfect), manteniendo coherencia temporal. A es incorrecta porque... 'Didn't' (A) es pasado simple y rompería la conexión con el presente. C es incorrecta porque... 'Hadn't' (C) es past perfect, que requeriría un punto de referencia pasado anterior. TIP / RECUERDA: present perfect conecta una situación pasada con el presente.

questions.text: (52) ______, I find myself having to take work home just so that I can meet the deadlines.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... La oración anterior dice que la carga de trabajo no ha disminuido; esta oración añade que, por el contrario, debe llevarse trabajo a casa. B es incorrecta porque... 'Even though' (B) requiere una cláusula subordinada con sujeto y verbo. C es incorrecta porque... 'Despite' (C) requiere un sustantivo o gerundio, no una oración completa independiente. TIP / RECUERDA: even though + clause; despite + noun/gerund; on the contrary introduce contraste.

questions.text: It's wearing me out trying to juggle work with (53) ______ my family.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... 'Look after' significa 'cuidar de', lo cual encaja perfectamente con el contexto de conciliar trabajo y familia. A es incorrecta porque... 'Take up' (A) significa 'empezar un hobby / ocupar espacio'. C es incorrecta porque... 'Bring along' (C) significa 'traer consigo'.

questions.text: I work for a global IT company, but (54) ______ their headquarters is in the States, I do all my work online from home.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... 'Because' introduce una cláusula subordinada causal con sujeto y verbo ('their headquarters is...'). B es incorrecta porque... 'Due to' (B) debe ir seguido de un sustantivo o gerundio, no de una oración completa. C es incorrecta porque... 'Thus' (C) es un conector consecutivo, no causal, y no encaja lógicamente aquí.

questions.text: That means that I don't waste time (55) ______ or making idle chit-chat with colleagues.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque... 'Commute' significa 'trasladarse diariamente al trabajo'. A es incorrecta porque... 'Transferring' (A) implica cambio de lugar o traslado permanente, no el trayecto diario. C es incorrecta porque... 'Going' (C) es demasiado vago y no es la colocación específica para este contexto laboral.

questions.text: ...I can easily take some time off if I need to (56) ______ an appointment with the dentist.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... 'Schedule an appointment' es la colocación estándar en inglés estadounidense para 'programar una cita'. A es incorrecta porque... 'Call' (A) requeriría 'call to make an appointment'. B es incorrecta porque... 'Separate' (B) no tiene sentido en este contexto.

questions.text: ...I found it really hard to concentrate because there were just (57) ______ distractions around.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... 'Distractions' es un sustantivo contable en plural, por lo que requiere 'many'. B es incorrecta porque... 'Much' (B) se usa con sustantivos incontables. C es incorrecta porque... 'A lot' (C) necesitaría la preposición 'of' antes del sustantivo ('a lot of distractions'). TIP / RECUERDA: many + countable plural; much + uncountable; a lot of + ambos.

questions.text: (58) ______, I started to go to a nearby café to work, but the Wi-Fi connection wasn't ideal...
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... El contexto muestra una consecuencia lógica: debido a las distracciones en casa, decidió ir a un café. A es incorrecta porque... 'For instance' (A) introduce ejemplos, no consecuencias. B es incorrecta porque... 'Although' (B) introduce concesión, lo cual no encaja porque no hay contraste entre la oración anterior y esta; más bien hay causa-efecto.

questions.text: ...I decided to rent a desk in a co-working space with five other freelancers like (59) ______.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque... 'Other freelancers like myself' es una construcción formal y gramaticalmente aceptada en inglés, equivalente a 'like me'. B es incorrecta porque... 'Herself' (B) no concuerda con el sujeto 'I'. C es incorrecta porque... 'Yourself' (C) cambiaría la persona del discurso.

questions.text: ...so it's nice to have workmates to bounce ideas (60) ______ as well.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque... El phrasal verb 'bounce ideas off someone' es una expresión idiomática que significa 'discutir ideas con alguien para obtener retroalimentación'. A es incorrecta porque... 'Bounce back' (A) significa 'recuperarse'. B es incorrecta porque... 'Bounce into' (B) no es una colocación estándar en este contexto profesional.

questions.text: Dario wants his students to work on written cohesion before they start writing their own article. Which of the following strategies is appropriate to achieve Dario's purpose?
options: The teacher brings envelopes that contain pieces of an article that he has previously cut up and mixed up. Next, he groups the students, gives each group an envelope and asks them to put the parts of the article in the correct order. Then they check the order of the article as a whole class.

The teacher gives each student a five-paragraph article and writes some sentences on the board. Next, he asks the students to insert the sentences in the most logical place within the paragraphs. Then they compare their choices with a classmate.

The teacher gives the students an article that has some blanks. Next, he asks the students to fill in the blanks with an appropriate signal or reference word. Then the students get in groups to check their answers.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque completar los espacios con signal/reference words hace que los estudiantes trabajen directamente los recursos lingüísticos que unen ideas y oraciones, es decir, la cohesión textual. A es incorrecta porque ordenar partes del artículo trabaja principalmente la secuencia y organización global del contenido. B es incorrecta porque insertar oraciones en el lugar más lógico se relaciona con la coherencia y la organización del párrafo, no con los mecanismos explícitos de cohesión. TIP / RECUERDA: Cohesión = cómo se conectan las partes del texto; coherencia = cómo las ideas tienen sentido y se organizan globalmente.

questions.text: Bartolomé wants his students to discuss the following question: "Should tablets replace textbooks in high schools?" During the discussion, Bartolomé wants his students to use the following expressions: • I think your idea is pretty accurate. However, we should consider... • Could you say that again, please? • I'm sorry, I did not get your point. • It's important that you... Which of the following language functions is NOT involved in the expressions above?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque ninguna de las expresiones expresa una respuesta a un elogio; el conjunto sí incluye pedir aclaraciones y persuadir. A es incorrecta porque "Could you say that again, please?" y "I'm sorry, I did not get your point" son fórmulas para pedir clarificación. C es incorrecta porque "It's important that you..." y "However, we should consider..." buscan influir en la opinión del interlocutor, por lo que sí cumplen una función persuasiva.

questions.text: Ofelia wants to help her third-grade students improve their listening skills using authentic listening resources on movie reviews. Which of the following activities is using those types of resources?
options: The students listen to the recording of a graded level movie review. Then they discuss if they agree or not with the comments given in the review.
The students listen to a movie review podcast. After that, based on the content of the podcast, they make a comic strip that depicts the story of the movie.
The students listen to an audio of a movie review recorded by their teacher and a colleague. Next, based on the information heard, the students identify the elements of the movie.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque un podcast de una reseña de películas es un material creado para una audiencia real y no específicamente para enseñar inglés, por lo que funciona como authentic listening resource. A es incorrecta porque "graded level" indica que el recurso ha sido adaptado para estudiantes y, por tanto, no mantiene plenamente la autenticidad. C es incorrecta porque un audio producido por docentes es un material didáctico creado para la clase, no un recurso auténtico.

questions.text: Abel has noticed that his students usually have difficulties managing their time when working in group discussions and, as a consequence, they don't finish the activities assigned. Aware of that situation, he wants to help his students manage their time better. Which of the following actions is NOT appropriate to achieve his purpose?
options: Let students work and, when the time is over, collect only the products of the groups that have finished the activity. This way, students in other groups will manage their time better in future activities.

Set time limits before the activity starts and, while the students are working, remind them occasionally how much time they still have ahead. This way, the students will try to finish the task on time.
Assign each student of the group a role (time controller, secretary, reporter, etc.). This way, they will stay focused on the role they were assigned and won't get distracted from the task.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque recoger solo los productos terminados no enseña a los estudiantes estrategias para planificar y autorregular su tiempo; solo penaliza el resultado. B es incorrecta porque establecer límites y recordar el tiempo restante ofrece un apoyo concreto para desarrollar autorregulación y gestión del tiempo. C es incorrecta porque asignar roles, incluido un time controller, distribuye responsabilidades y ayuda a mantener el foco durante el trabajo grupal. TIP / RECUERDA: Para desarrollar una habilidad de gestión, la intervención debe enseñar estrategias, no limitarse a castigar el incumplimiento.

questions.text: During a speaking session, Sara provides the students with the following input: A says: Great, thank you. And is there a good restaurant in this part of town? A says: Excuse me, can you help me? A says: OK, thanks for your help. A says: Are there any good cafés near here? B says: Yes, Café Milano is the best in town. You should definitely go there. B says: No, but there's one near the station. B says: Yes, of course. B says: No problem. First, Sara gives each student a copy of the conversation above. She asks them to put the 5 sentences in the correct order, following the logical sequence of the conversation and paying attention to how well the ideas fit together. Which of the following aspects of language is involved in Sara's activity?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque ordenar las líneas para que la conversación tenga sentido lógico trabaja la coherencia: las ideas deben relacionarse y formar un discurso globalmente comprensible. A es incorrecta porque fluency se refiere a la capacidad de producir lenguaje oral con continuidad, no a organizar líneas de una conversación escrita. B es incorrecta porque cohesion se centra en los recursos lingüísticos que enlazan las partes del texto, no en decidir cuál es el orden lógico de las ideas.

questions.text: Considering the content of the conversation (A asks for help/directions to cafés/restaurants; B gives directions/recommendations), which of the following functions is involved in it?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque las preguntas de A buscan información sobre la ubicación de restaurantes y cafés ("in this part of town", "near here"), por lo que la función principal es asking for location. B es incorrecta porque giving directions corresponde a la información que proporciona B, no a la función que se identifica en las intervenciones de A. C es incorrecta porque B no está ofreciendo ayuda de manera espontánea; está respondiendo a una solicitud concreta de información.

questions.text: Next, Sara would like her students to practice the conversation using their nonverbal and paraverbal sources. She is about to give the students some instructions to practice the conversation. Which would be the least appropriate instruction to accomplish Sara's aim?
options: "Practice the conversation using the right pace to deliver the information thoroughly. Don't forget to focus on your body language."
"Practice the conversation using the right tone to convey your message clearly. Also, remember that you have to focus on your facial expressions."
"Practice the conversation using the right pronunciation to make sure your classmates understand you. Additionally, be ready to say your lines correctly."
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque se centra en pronunciation y en decir las líneas correctamente, mientras que el propósito es practicar recursos no verbales y paraverbales. A es incorrecta porque pace y body language sí corresponden al objetivo: ritmo de habla y lenguaje corporal. B es incorrecta porque tone y facial expressions también pertenecen al componente paraverbal y no verbal de la comunicación. TIP / RECUERDA: Paraverbal = cómo se dice (tone, pace, volume); no verbal = gestos, postura y expresiones faciales.

questions.text: During a writing session, Rosa has asked her students to imagine they have a friend in another country. She asks them to write an e-mail to that friend describing their vacation plans. Before the students write the text, Rosa wants them to make an outline. Which of the following strategies is appropriate to achieve the teacher's purpose?
options: Tell the students to write some sentences describing their vacation plans and put those sentences into paragraphs. Ask the students to connect the sentences and paragraphs using varied linking words. Then ask the students to exchange their paragraphs with a classmate for correction.

Tell the students to make a list of their vacation plans and add some details about each plan. Ask the students to use brief and concise information in each plan. Last, ask them to compare their list with a partner and give each other suggestions on how to improve it.

Tell the students to write, in their notebooks, as many ideas as possible about their vacation plans. Ask the students to choose the information they consider more interesting to include in their texts. Next, ask the students to share their ideas with a classmate.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque un outline organiza ideas principales y detalles breves que servirán como guía antes de redactar el texto. A es incorrecta porque ya pide redactar oraciones y párrafos completos y trabajar conectores; eso corresponde a la fase de drafting/revising, no al outline. C es incorrecta porque generar muchas ideas y luego seleccionar las más relevantes corresponde al brainstorming, una técnica de generación de ideas previa a la organización del esquema. TIP / RECUERDA: Brainstorming genera ideas; outline las organiza para orientar la escritura.

questions.text: Luisa's students are going to watch a short video about popular sports among young people. She wants to engage the students in a meaningful activity before they watch the video. Which of the following activities is most appropriate to achieve Luisa's purpose?
options: The teacher shows the students pictures of sports and athletes. Next, the students mention what they see in the pictures and the teacher writes this information on the board.
The teacher gets the students to brainstorm words connected to sports. They write the words in their notebooks and then they share the words with the whole class.
The teacher writes questions related to the sports the students play or would like to play. They discuss the questions in pairs and then report their answers to the class.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque las preguntas sobre experiencias y preferencias de los estudiantes generan una conexión personal con el tema y un intercambio de significado antes de ver el video. A es incorrecta porque principalmente pide identificar y nombrar lo que aparece en imágenes, sin una conexión personal suficiente. B es incorrecta porque activa vocabulario relacionado con sports, pero no asegura que los estudiantes relacionen el contenido con sus propias experiencias. TIP / RECUERDA: Una actividad meaningful antes de un video debe preparar el tema y, de ser posible, conectar el contenido con la experiencia del estudiante.

questions.text: Amanda wants the students in her class to use the following expressions in a dialogue: • I'd rather go to ... • It's very kind of you, but... • Actually, I think I'm going to pass on it. • Let me sleep on it. Which of the following language functions is Amanda trying to promote with the expressions above?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque expresiones como "It's very kind of you, but...", "pass on it" y "sleep on it" se usan para rechazar o posponer una oferta de manera cortés. A es incorrecta porque no se está refutando una opinión de otra persona. B es incorrecta porque aunque "I'd rather..." puede expresar preferencia, el conjunto de expresiones tiene una función más específica: declinar una oferta.

questions.text: Maximiliano wants to use bottom-up processing to help his students develop their listening skills. He has thought of three activities to be presented before the students listen to the talk "Stay safe during an earthquake." Which of the activities he has thought of is related to bottom-up processing?
options: The teacher gives each student a list of key words from the talk. He practices the pronunciation of the words with the students. While listening, the students underline the words mentioned in the talk.

The teacher shows some pictures that are related to the talk and some pictures that aren't. Next, in pairs, the students decide which pictures are related to earthquakes and explain the reasons of their choice.

The teacher writes on the board the title of the talk. He asks the students to think of the possible content of the talk and write their ideas in their notebooks. Then they listen to the talk to check their predictions.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque el bottom-up processing construye la comprensión a partir de elementos lingüísticos pequeños; reconocer y practicar palabras concretas durante la escucha exige atención a esos componentes. B es incorrecta porque usar imágenes y relacionarlas con el tema activa conocimientos y esquemas previos, un proceso principalmente top-down. C es incorrecta porque predecir el contenido a partir del título también activa conocimientos previos y corresponde al procesamiento top-down. TIP / RECUERDA: Bottom-up = de palabras/sonidos hacia el significado global; top-down = de conocimientos previos hacia la interpretación del mensaje.

questions.text: Before the students read the text, Daisy wants to activate the students' prior knowledge about the story. Which of the following activities is NOT appropriate to carry out?
options: Tell the students they are going to read the story of "The Ugly Duckling" using a puzzle that contains parts of the written story. Divide the class into groups of four students and give each group an envelope containing a copy of the story split into pieces. Ask the students to put the pieces together and then read the story to the whole class.

Stick, on the board, pictures of the characters of the story. Write the names of the characters under each picture: The Ugly Duckling, Mother Duck, swan, etc. Pair up the students and ask them to tell each other what they know about the story. Then ask some volunteers to share their ideas aloud.

Show the students the cover of the story "The Ugly Duckling." On the board, write some questions to predict what comes in the story. Pair up the students and ask them to answer the questions together. Then invite some students to share their answers with the rest of the class.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque armar el texto completo con fragmentos antes de leer no activa saberes previos ni genera expectativas sobre el contenido; introduce directamente el input. B es incorrecta porque las imágenes de los personajes y la conversación sobre lo que ya conocen activan esquemas previos. C es incorrecta porque la portada y las preguntas de predicción preparan al lector mediante anticipaciones antes de la lectura. TIP / RECUERDA: En pre-reading se busca activar conocimientos, formular predicciones y preparar el propósito de lectura antes de analizar el texto.

questions.text: After the students read the text once, Daisy wants them to interpret information from it. Which of the following questions is appropriate for the teacher's purpose?
options: Why did The Ugly Duckling live in the barn for some time?
Why did Mother Duck say "but never mind. I'm sure you've got a heart of gold"?
Why did the other animals reject The Ugly Duckling when he wanted to play with them?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque interpretar exige inferir la intención y actitud de Mother Duck a partir de la frase "I'm sure you've got a heart of gold", no solo recuperar un dato literal. A es incorrecta porque el texto explica directamente que el patito se queda en el granero después de perderse y buscar un lugar seguro. C es incorrecta porque la causa del rechazo aparece explícitamente cuando los otros animales dicen "you are ugly", por lo que solo requiere recuperar información.

questions.text: Here are some sentences that the characters used in the story: • "You do look different from my other ducklings...but never mind. I'm sure you've got a heart of gold." • "Even though I'm not fluffy and golden as my brothers and sisters are, I'm just as good! -- and I'm even better at swimming!" • "Our growing process takes longer. Still, we have to be patient." Which of the following language functions is related to the expressions in bold?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque "but never mind", "Even though" y "Still" relacionan ideas mediante contraste o concesión. B es incorrecta porque ninguna de las expresiones comunica incredulidad, duda o falta de confianza en la información. C es incorrecta porque no reformulan una idea previa; introducen una idea que se contrapone o limita a otra.

questions.text: Next, Daisy writes some questions on the board and asks the students to discuss them in pairs. Here are the questions she presents: • What do you think about the behavior of the characters in the story? • What would you do if you were The Ugly Duckling's mother? • What did you learn from the story? What is Daisy aiming at with the questions presented?
options: Having the students retrieve explicit information.
Having the students develop critical thinking skills.
Having the students summarize the content of the text.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque las preguntas piden evaluar conductas, adoptar otra perspectiva y extraer aprendizajes personales; todas exigen una respuesta reflexiva y no solo recuperación literal. A es incorrecta porque recuperar información explícita implica localizar datos que el texto presenta directamente. C es incorrecta porque resumir consiste en sintetizar la información principal del texto, mientras que aquí se solicita valorar, imaginar y reflexionar. TIP / RECUERDA: Critical thinking suele implicar analizar, evaluar, justificar, tomar postura o transferir lo comprendido a nuevas situaciones.

questions.text: After the students have worked on different comprehension tasks, Daisy wants them to develop their writing skills through a post-reading task. Which of the following tasks is more appropriate to carry out?
options: Ask the students to write an extra paragraph about the future of the duckling after realizing he was a beautiful swan.
Write, on the board, five questions about the text and ask the students to answer them using the information provided in the story.
Encourage the students to make a list of words that were new for them in the text and ask them to make a sentence with each of those words in their notebooks.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque escribir un párrafo nuevo sobre el futuro del personaje exige producción escrita propia, creatividad y uso del lenguaje en un contexto relacionado con la lectura. B es incorrecta porque responder preguntas sobre información del cuento mantiene el foco principal en reading comprehension. C es incorrecta porque identificar vocabulario nuevo y usarlo en oraciones aisladas trabaja principalmente vocabulary development, no una producción escrita extensa. TIP / RECUERDA: Una post-reading extension debe llevar al estudiante a usar lo comprendido para producir algo nuevo, no solo repetir información.

questions.text:
Thalia wants her students to practice demonstratives (this/that/these/those). She has thought of the following strategies:

Strategy 1: • The teacher writes the following sentences on the board: This blouse is beautiful. / Those jeans are expensive. / That jacket is nice. / These shorts are comfortable. • Then she draws the following chart on the board: Near | Far Singular: this | that Plural: these | those • Finally, she explains the rules on how to use demonstratives and asks the students to provide their own examples.

Strategy 2: • The teacher tells the students to imagine they are packing their clothing before going on a trip. • She writes the following prompts on the board: Put those... in the bag. / Do you want that...? / No, thanks, but I want these... / Don't forget this... • Then, in pairs, the students develop a dialogue using the prompts.

Strategy 3: • The teacher shows her cellphone and says the following: "This cellphone is mine." • Then she asks the following questions: "Is the noun cellphone singular or plural?" and "Is the cellphone near me or far from me?" • The students answer the questions. Then the teacher follows the same procedure using other objects.

Which of the strategies Thalia has thought of corresponds to the Functional approach?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque el Functional Approach prioriza el uso del lenguaje para cumplir una función comunicativa dentro de una situación con propósito. La estrategia 2 hace que los estudiantes usen this/that/these/those mientras realizan una tarea significativa. A es incorrecta porque explica reglas y presenta una tabla antes de pedir ejemplos, por lo que el foco es deductivo y gramatical. C es incorrecta porque, aunque parte de ejemplos y preguntas inductivas, el uso sigue siendo muy controlado y no existe una necesidad comunicativa auténtica. TIP / RECUERDA: En el enfoque funcional, la pregunta clave es "¿para qué necesita el estudiante usar esta lengua en contexto?".

questions.text: Marisela's students are participating in a debate as part of a free speaking activity. While debating, a student forgets a word, stops speaking, and makes some effort to remember the word. Given that situation, which could be the best way to correct the student's mistake?
options: Say the word the student has forgotten and ask him to repeat the word after her.
Call on a volunteer to help the student recall the word he has forgotten.
Tell the student not to worry and ask him to carry on with his argument.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque en free speaking la prioridad es mantener la fluidez y el significado; permitir que el estudiante continúe evita romper el flujo de su intervención. A es incorrecta porque proporcionar inmediatamente la palabra y pedir repetición interrumpe la producción y desplaza el foco hacia la precisión léxica. B es incorrecta porque incorporar a otro estudiante para recuperar la palabra también interrumpe la autonomía y continuidad del hablante. TIP / RECUERDA: En actividades centradas en fluency, la corrección debe evitar interrupciones innecesarias; en actividades centradas en accuracy, el foco puede desplazarse hacia la forma.

questions.text: Aldo's fifth-grade students are reading an article called "Cultures around the world," and he wants to check students' understanding of the content through formative assessment. Which of the following activities is NOT appropriate to achieve Aldo's purpose?
options: The students work in groups to make a poster about the article. After that, they present the posters to the whole class. Aldo uses a rubric to give a score to each of the presentations of the posters.

The students work in groups to draw a concept map about the article. Next, they hand in their maps to the teacher. Aldo uses a checklist to monitor reading comprehension and writes some recommendations if needed.

The students work in pairs to discuss some open-ended questions about the article. Then they share their answers with another pair. While the students are discussing the questions, Aldo walks around the classroom and makes some comments about the students' answers.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque una rúbrica usada para asignar un score a un producto final se orienta a calificar el desempeño, no a recoger evidencias para ajustar el aprendizaje durante el proceso. B es incorrecta porque el checklist permite monitorear la comprensión y ofrecer recomendaciones para mejorar, lo que sí es formativo. C es incorrecta porque la observación durante la interacción y los comentarios del docente permiten retroalimentar el aprendizaje en tiempo real. TIP / RECUERDA: Formative assessment = recoger evidencias para mejorar durante el proceso; summative assessment = valorar el resultado al final.

questions.text:
Luz is checking the written production of her second-grade students. They presented a short text describing the routine of a member of their family. Leonardo, one of her students, has handed in his first version of the text:

My brother is a student. He wakes up 7am. He has breakfast 7.20. We go school 8am. Next, he studies 8.15am and 1pm. He does homework 4pm. He watches TV and has lunch. He sleeps 10pm.

Luz will check Leonardo's text. Which of the following aspects should be prioritized in the revision of Leonardo's text?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque el error más sistemático del texto está en la ausencia o uso incorrecto de preposiciones necesarias para expresar horas y destino: "at 7 a.m.", "at 7.20", "go to school", etc. A es incorrecta porque el orden básico de las palabras suele mantenerse comprensible y no constituye el problema predominante del texto. C es incorrecta porque el present simple es coherente con una rutina y los verbos ya aparecen en el tiempo adecuado.

questions.text: During a reading session, Oswaldo's students are giving the text a first reading. While reading, a student raises his hand and asks the teacher for the meaning of the phrasal verb "back up." Which of the following actions is better for the teacher to carry out?
options: Tell the student that, at this point, it is important to understand the general idea. Then point out that there will be a moment to check vocabulary as a whole class. When the students finish reading, ask them to circle the words they don't understand in order to clarify their meaning.

Tell the student that the phrasal verb "back up" is similar in meaning to "support" or "confirm," but that it's more informal. Then give the student an example using "back up." After that, encourage the student to think of another situation in which he could use that phrasal verb.

Tell the student what a phrasal verb is and explain the meaning of "back up" in English. If the student doesn't understand the meaning of that phrasal verb, translate it into Spanish. Finally, ask the student if he has problems with the meaning of other words in the text.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque en la primera lectura el propósito es obtener el gist; posponer el trabajo léxico permite mantener la atención en el significado global sin interrumpir el proceso de lectura. B es incorrecta porque detiene la lectura para explicar un phrasal verb concreto, desviando el foco del objetivo de esa primera lectura. C es incorrecta porque añade una explicación gramatical y traducción al español en medio de la lectura, lo que interfiere todavía más con la comprensión global. TIP / RECUERDA: En skimming/reading for gist, no es necesario resolver cada palabra desconocida; primero comprende de qué trata el texto.

questions.text:
Teófilo has noticed that some of the students seem uninterested and bored at the beginning of the lessons. He asks his colleagues to suggest an activity to start his lesson. Here are some of the activities his colleagues recommend:

Bernardo says: "I suggest an activity that helps activate students' schemata. It is a good way to make sure they get familiar with the topic." Carmen says: "You should start the lesson with an activity in which the students introduce each other. That way, they will feel more relaxed." Dionisio says: "Maybe you can involve the students in an activity such as a game or an energizer. This will engage your students and get them in the mood to learn."

Which of Teófilo's colleagues has suggested a warm-up?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque un warm-up es breve, dinámico y motivador; un juego o energizer ayuda a activar al grupo y prepararlo emocionalmente para aprender. A es incorrecta porque activar schemata prepara principalmente el conocimiento y contexto del contenido, lo que corresponde más al lead-in. B es incorrecta porque presentar a compañeros puede favorecer la interacción social, pero no define por sí mismo una actividad breve de activación y energía. TIP / RECUERDA: Warm-up prepara el estado de ánimo y la disposición; lead-in conecta cognitivamente con el tema.

questions.text:
Irene would like her students to perform a roleplay, within the context of two language functions. For this purpose, she provides them with these expressions: • What happened? How are you feeling? • Are you ok? You look worried. • Is everything under control? • Before you move on, I'd like to say... • Can I just add something here?

Which two language functions are the ones Irene would like her students to practice?
options: Expressing concern / interrupting another speaker politely.
Asking about other people's opinions / clarifying or arranging one's ideas.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque las primeras expresiones muestran preocupación por el estado de otra persona y las últimas permiten intervenir de manera cortés para añadir una idea. A es incorrecta porque no hay expresiones para elogiar a alguien ni para establecer reglas o pautas. C es incorrecta porque no se está solicitando la opinión del interlocutor ni organizando una idea propia; se está mostrando concern e interrumpiendo politeamente.

questions.text:
Anna's students are going to listen to the following conversation: A: I saw the movie "The walker" yesterday. B: Really! How did you like it? A: I loved it! The soundtrack and the special effects were amazing. B: Oh yeah! The special effects really impressed me too.

Before the students listen to the conversation, Anna gives the following instructions: "You are going to listen to a short conversation between two friends. Listen to it once and answer: What is the subject of the conversation?"

Which skill is the teacher trying to develop with her question?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque preguntar por el subject de la conversación obliga a identificar de qué trata el audio en términos generales, que es listening for gist. B es incorrecta porque inferir attitude requeriría interpretar sentimientos, opiniones o actitudes de los hablantes. C es incorrecta porque listening for details implica localizar datos concretos, no determinar simplemente el tema general. TIP / RECUERDA: Gist = "¿de qué trata?"; details = "¿qué dato específico aparece?".

questions.text:
Victor's third-grade students have written a text in which they give advice to a friend. Now, the teacher is correcting the students' texts. Here is a comment he has written in one of the students' texts:

"This is a great text. You have included really useful pieces of advice to help your friend solve a problem. However, you could have used more of the expressions to give advice we studied in our previous lesson."

Based on the comment above, what was Victor's feedback focus?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque el comentario valora si el estudiante está usando las expresiones de advice trabajadas previamente, es decir, el uso funcional de recursos lingüísticos aprendidos. A es incorrecta porque no se comenta organización de ideas, párrafos ni estructura global del texto. B es incorrecta porque accuracy se centra en la corrección formal; el docente no señala errores, sino que indica que faltó incorporar recursos lingüísticos estudiados.

questions.text: During a reading session, Hubner's students have answered some questions related to the text they have just read. Before he calls on volunteers, he asks them to compare their answers in pairs. Which of the following purposes is involved in Hubner's action?
options: He wants to give the students some thinking time.
He wants to make sure that the students complete the task quickly.
He wants to give the students confidence before the whole class hears their answers.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque comparar respuestas en parejas antes de responder ante toda la clase reduce la ansiedad y permite comprobar las propias ideas con un compañero, aumentando la seguridad para participar. A es incorrecta porque el pair checking puede dar tiempo para pensar, pero ese no es el propósito principal señalado por la estrategia. B es incorrecta porque la finalidad no es terminar más rápido, sino preparar mejor la participación pública. TIP / RECUERDA: Think/pair/share y pair checking pueden funcionar como scaffolding para aumentar confianza antes de la participación plenaria.

questions.text:
Susana's students have been practicing how to ask and answer information questions. However, some students still have problems formulating this kind of questions. Aware of that, Susana wants to help her students improve their accuracy. She has thought of the three following activities:

Activity 1: The teacher writes five incorrect information questions on the board. She pairs up the students and asks them to identify the mistakes and correct them. Then the students explain, to the rest of the class, the reasons for the corrections they made.

Activity 2: The teacher brings copies of a song that contains information questions and gives each student a copy of it. She asks them to circle the information questions in the song. Finally, the teacher plays the song and invites the students to sing it together.

Activity 3: The teacher pairs up the students and gives each pair a set of scrambled information questions. The students unscramble the questions and share the correct order of the questions with the whole class.

Which of the activities Susana has thought of is least appropriate for her purpose?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque reconocer preguntas dentro de una canción y luego cantarlas no exige formular correctamente las preguntas; por eso es la menos adecuada para mejorar accuracy. A es incorrecta porque identificar y corregir errores de preguntas obliga a analizar la forma y justificar la corrección. C es incorrecta porque ordenar partes de una pregunta ayuda a reconstruir la estructura interrogativa y practicar su forma correcta. TIP / RECUERDA: Accuracy improves when students attend actively to form, detect errors and produce the correct structure.

questions.text:
Margot's students are going to have a conversation in pairs about "the qualifications needed to be elected as the school Mayor." She asks her students to include the expressions they have been practicing for class discussions: • As a rule... • By and large... • On the whole... • What normally happens is...

Which of the following language functions corresponds to the expressions Margot wants her students to practice?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque "As a rule", "By and large", "On the whole" y "What normally happens is" introducen afirmaciones generales sobre patrones habituales. A es incorrecta porque expresar hopes implica deseos o expectativas, no generalizaciones. C es incorrecta porque degrees of certainty se expresan con recursos como "maybe", "probably" o "definitely"; las expresiones dadas generalizan, no gradúan certeza.

questions.text: During the past few sessions, Wilmer's students have been practicing the function "Greeting and introducing people." Now, he wants them to use that function through a speaking communicative activity. Given this goal, which of the following activities is it more appropriate to carry out?
options: The teacher elicits some expressions used to greet and introduce people, and writes them on the board. Then he forms groups of three and sets a context for each group: friends at a party, students in a new class, etc. He tells the students to perform a conversation including some of the expressions written on the board.

The teacher gives each student the copy of a conversation of two students greeting and introducing themselves. He pairs up the students and asks them to practice the conversation for some minutes. Then he invites some volunteers to present the conversation in front of the class.

The teacher gives the students a handout that contains expressions to greet and introduce people. Then he asks the students to stand up and mingle in order to greet a classmate using the expressions in the handout. Next, they continue to greet different classmates for about five minutes.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque ofrece contextos diferentes, roles y una situación comunicativa que exige producir conversaciones propias usando la función target. B es incorrecta porque memorizar y repetir un diálogo dado limita la creatividad y la negociación de significado. C es incorrecta porque el "mingle" aporta interacción, pero repetir únicamente saludos breves no garantiza una conversación suficientemente desarrollada para practicar la función de manera amplia.

questions.text: At the beginning of the session, Mario gives each student the reviews of two products, an iron and a microwave oven. Then he sticks the pictures of those two products on the board. Next, he asks the students to read the reviews and decide which picture each review is describing. Which reading skill does Mario want to promote with his activity?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque para relacionar cada review con un producto los estudiantes necesitan captar la idea global de cada texto, es decir, hacer skimming. A es incorrecta porque scanning consiste en localizar información específica, como un precio, una característica o un nombre. C es incorrecta porque predicting ocurre antes de la lectura, mientras que aquí los estudiantes ya leen para identificar el producto correspondiente. TIP / RECUERDA: Skimming busca el gist; scanning busca datos puntuales.

questions.text:
After having done some reading comprehension activities, Mario tells the students to paraphrase, orally, the review of the microwave oven, which is the following:

"I'm sorry to say I'm very disappointed with this microwave oven. It's big, awful and very heavy, so I can't carry it. It's also very difficult to use. So overall, it's definitely not worth the money and it's very poor value. Also, it was nearly two weeks late. My advice is don't buy it." Jen Swift

Retrieved from Hugues, J. & Wood, K. (2019). Navigate Elementary. Unit 5 p. 53. Oxford University Press.

These are some of the students' samples. Which one shows paraphrasing skills?
options: Juan says: "Jen is very mad at the company that sent her the product. I think the product is ugly and big so I wouldn't buy it. It was too expensive and didn't arrive on time. In my opinion, the product is terrible and the company, too."

Alicia says: "Jen is really unhappy with a product. The product is large, horrible, weighty and not easy to operate. In general, it is not good value for money. Besides, it arrived two weeks late approximately. She recommends not buying it."

Lucia says: "Jen is very disappointed with this product. It's big, awful, and very heavy so she can't carry it. It's also very difficult to use. It is definitely not worth the money and it's poor value. Also, it was nearly two weeks late. Her advice is don't buy it."
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque una paráfrasis mantiene el significado original pero cambia la forma lingüística; Alicia sustituye vocabulario y estructuras sin alterar el contenido esencial. A es incorrecta porque incorpora opiniones personales que no aparecen en el texto original, por lo que añade significado. C es incorrecta porque conserva casi las mismas palabras y estructuras de la reseña original; eso es repetición, no paráfrasis. TIP / RECUERDA: Paraphrasing = same meaning, different wording.

questions.text: Mario wants his students to work on a meaningful extension activity in which they will write a product review. He has thought of three different activities. Which of the activities Mario has thought of is appropriate to achieve his purpose?
options: The teacher brings cards with the name of different products in each one. He asks the students to randomly pick a card. After that, they write a review of the product.
The teacher gives the students a review of a product. He asks them to highlight the key words in it. Then they rewrite the review substituting the key words.
The teacher tells the students to think about the products they have at home. He asks them to choose one of those products. Next, they write a review of it.
