questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque elegir un producto real de casa conecta la tarea con la experiencia del estudiante y genera una producción relevante y auténtica. A es incorrecta porque asignar un producto al azar puede reducir la conexión personal y, por tanto, la significatividad de la escritura. B es incorrecta porque sustituir palabras de un modelo es una práctica controlada de transformación, no una extensión creativa e independiente.

questions.text:
Antonio wants to help his students develop their listening skills. For this purpose, they will listen to an interview of a celebrity. He has designed the following listening activity:

The teacher asks the students to listen to an audio. They will listen three times with different purposes: • First listening: The students listen to recognize the type of oral interaction, as well as the roles of the speakers in the audio. They check their findings in pairs and volunteer to share their answers with the whole class. • Second listening: The teacher asks the students to identify some of the questions used in the audio. Then, in pairs, they compare the questions they got. • Third listening: The students listen to analyze the reporter's mood while asking the questions. Also, they try to identify the celebrity's reaction when answering the questions.

Which listening skill is involved in the second listening of the sequence?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque en la segunda escucha se pide identificar preguntas concretas del audio; eso implica localizar información específica y explícita. A es incorrecta porque la comprensión global corresponde a la primera escucha, donde se identifican tipo de interacción y roles. B es incorrecta porque inferir meaning from context implica deducir significados implícitos o de vocabulario, no simplemente identificar preguntas que se oyen. TIP / RECUERDA: Escuchar para detalles significa buscar elementos concretos del input.

questions.text: Which of the following listening skills is involved in the third listening of the sequence?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque interpretar el mood del reportero y la reacción de la celebridad requiere inferir actitudes a partir del tono, la entonación, las palabras y otros indicios paraverbales. B es incorrecta porque la tarea no pide localizar palabras como however, therefore o but. C es incorrecta porque deducing meaning from context suele referirse a interpretar el significado de palabras o expresiones desconocidas, no a estados emocionales.

questions.text:
Renzo's students are going to work in pairs in order to talk about challenging situations they have gone through. After Renzo has assigned each student a role and given instructions for the activity, he writes the following expressions on the board: • What a shame! • That's too bad. • What a let-down!

Considering the expressions above, which of the following language functions is Renzo going to promote with his activity?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque "What a shame!", "That's too bad" y "What a let-down!" expresan decepción ante una situación negativa o que no cumplió expectativas. B es incorrecta porque uncertainty se expresa con formas como "I'm not sure" o "Maybe", no con estas exclamaciones. C es incorrecta porque necessity expresa necesidad u obligación, por ejemplo "I need to" o "You must", algo ausente en las expresiones dadas.

questions.text: Camila's students are participating in a semi-controlled speaking activity about their holiday plans, while she is monitoring and correcting mistakes if necessary. Suddenly, she overhears Lucas, one of the students say, "I go to travel to Cusco." Since Camila wants to provide Lucas with a chance to correct himself, which of the following techniques is more appropriate to use?
options: Recast: Student says: "I go to travel to Cusco." Teacher says: "I'm going to travel to Cusco."
Repetition: Student says: "I go to travel to Cusco." Teacher says: "I go to travel?"
Clarification request: Student says: "I go to travel to Cusco." Teacher says: "Could you repeat your sentence?"
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque repetir "I go to travel?" con entonación interrogativa señala el error y deja que Lucas detecte la forma incorrecta y se autocorrija. A es incorrecta porque el recast proporciona directamente la forma correcta y puede reducir la oportunidad de que el estudiante produzca la autocorrección. C es incorrecta porque "Could you repeat your sentence?" funciona principalmente como clarification request y puede interpretarse como un problema de comprensión, no como una señal clara del error gramatical.

questions.text: Fernando has asked his students to have a conversation in which they talk about things they did in the past, but they wish they had not done. Which language function is better to achieve Fernando's purpose?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque hablar de acciones pasadas que uno lamenta y desearía no haber realizado corresponde a expressing regret. A es incorrecta porque apologizing implica pedir perdón a otra persona por una acción o daño. B es incorrecta porque showing sympathy consiste en reaccionar con comprensión ante la dificultad de otra persona, no en lamentar decisiones propias. TIP / RECUERDA: Regret = "I wish I hadn't..." ; apology = "I'm sorry for...".

questions.text: Patricia wants to check her students' listening comprehension through a communicative task. Given Patricia's goal, which of the following tasks is appropriate to carry out?
options: The students listen to a few radio news about a sports event and try to identify as many verbs as they can. Then they compare their answers in pairs.
The students listen to an audio of a man who has to make a difficult choice in his life. They get in pairs and come up with a solution for his problem.
The students listen to the recording of a conversation about global warming. Then they answer some questions about the audio in writing.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque los estudiantes comprenden un audio y usan esa información para resolver un problema con un compañero, lo que convierte el listening en una tarea comunicativa con propósito. A es incorrecta porque identificar verbos aísla elementos lingüísticos y no exige construir significado para interactuar. C es incorrecta porque responder preguntas por escrito comprueba comprensión, pero no constituye una tarea comunicativa interpersonal. TIP / RECUERDA: En una communicative task, el input debe servir para actuar, decidir, resolver o interactuar, no solo para marcar respuestas.

questions.text: Maribel's students are writing an essay. Now, they are making sure that the sentences and paragraphs they wrote are well connected and that the details in their essays are closely related to the topic. They are also checking punctuation and spelling. Taking into account the actions the students are carrying out, in which stage of the writing process are they?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque revisar la conexión entre oraciones y párrafos, la relación de los detalles con el tema y aspectos como puntuación y ortografía corresponde a la fase de revising/editing. A es incorrecta porque planning ocurre antes de redactar y se centra en generar y organizar ideas. B es incorrecta porque drafting consiste en producir la primera versión; aquí los estudiantes ya están evaluando y mejorando un texto existente. TIP / RECUERDA: Planning = planificar; drafting = redactar; revising/editing = revisar y mejorar.

questions.text:
Danny is going to teach "double comparatives" using the Presentation-Practice-Production method (PPP). The students have previously learned how to compare things. This is the teaching sequence he will follow: • The teacher asks if the students know how to dance some folk dances. After that, he shares his own experience, and then writes "The more I practice, the better I dance" on the board. • He writes some incomplete sentences with the same structure on the board. For example: The more you study... / The more I use English... / The less I sleep... The students complete the sentences with the teacher's help. • The teacher gives the students some time to discuss with a partner the way the new structure works. Then the teacher confirms or corrects the students' hypothesis. • The teacher gives each student a strip of paper with one half of a double comparative sentence. For example: One student receives the first half of the sentence: The more I eat vegetables,... Another student receives the second half of the sentence: The better I grow. • The students stand up to look for the student who has the missing half of their sentence. The teacher repeats this final exercise several times.

Which of the PPP method stages is missing in Danny's teaching sequence?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque la secuencia incluye presentación y práctica controlada, pero no una producción autónoma y personalizada de los double comparatives. A es incorrecta porque el ejemplo inicial "The more I practice, the better I dance" y la explicación del docente cumplen la función de presentation. C es incorrecta porque completar oraciones y unir mitades de estructuras constituyen práctica guiada/controlada. TIP / RECUERDA: PPP = Presentation → Practice → Production. La Production exige uso más libre y significativo.

questions.text:
Eugenia wants her students to discuss the following question: "Are video games one of the leading causes of violence among teenagers?" During the discussion, Eugenia wants her students to use the following expressions: • Chances are that... • My guess is that... • I wouldn't be surprised if...

Which of the following language functions is mostly involved in the expressions above?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque "Chances are that...", "My guess is that..." e "I wouldn't be surprised if..." permiten expresar conjeturas sobre algo incierto o probable. B es incorrecta porque making suggestions implica proponer acciones o alternativas, no especular sobre una situación. C es incorrecta porque making requests consiste en pedir algo al interlocutor, lo que no ocurre en estas expresiones.

questions.text:
Melina wants to help her students develop their listening skills. In a lesson about birthdays, she asks her students to listen to an audio whose transcript is as follows:

Rosalba says: Tommy, have you bought dad's birthday present yet? Tommy says: No, I haven't. I don't know what to buy. He's difficult to buy for. Rosalba says: Why don't you buy him something related to his new interest? Tommy says: Good idea. He's into gardening now, right? Rosalba says: Yes, he is.

After having worked on some comprehension activities, Melina writes a list of three items on the board: a flowerpot, a flashlight, and a watch. She asks the students to choose the item that would make an appropriate present for Tommy's dad. Then they have to justify their choice.

Based on Melina's activity, which listening skill does she want the students to develop?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque los estudiantes deben relacionar la pista "He's into gardening now" con una opción de regalo y deducir que una flowerpot es la alternativa más adecuada; esa relación no se encuentra expresada literalmente como "buy a flowerpot". A es incorrecta porque no se pide ordenar eventos o pasos de la conversación. C es incorrecta porque no se está deduciendo el significado de una palabra desconocida, sino haciendo una inferencia a partir de información contextual. TIP / RECUERDA: Inferir = conectar pistas del input para obtener una conclusión que no aparece literalmente.

questions.text: Finally, Melina wants to involve her students in a communicative post-listening activity. Which activity is NOT appropriate to reach Melina's goal?
options: The teacher groups the students and asks them to talk about a present they gave to their dads in the past. One student talks about the present and the others ask follow-up questions. They repeat the same procedure until all the members have participated.

The teacher pairs up the students and assigns each student a role: One student is Tommy and the other is Tommy's dad. They have to role-play a conversation in which Tommy is giving the present to his dad. Then they present their role-play in front of the class.

The teacher tells the students to individually think about other possible presents Tommy's father would like to get. They make a list and get ready to explain the reasons of their choices. Finally, the students read their lists and explain their reasons to the class.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque leer listas individuales y explicar razones ante la clase ofrece poca interacción oral sostenida; no exige intercambio continuo ni negociación de significado entre pares. A es incorrecta porque los follow-up questions generan intercambio real entre varios estudiantes. B es incorrecta porque el role-play crea una situación contextualizada con interlocutores y una finalidad comunicativa clara. TIP / RECUERDA: Post-listening communicative tasks deben llevar del input a una interacción significativa, no limitarse a reproducir información.

questions.text:
Ruben's fourth-grade students have finished writing a text on "The role of technology in education." Now, Ruben gives the students the following instructions: "Exchange your text with another classmate. Read the text and add some recommendations. Then return the text to your classmate so that he can improve it before handing in the last version."

Which of the following types of assessment is Ruben promoting with his instructions?
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque los estudiantes intercambian textos, leen el trabajo de un compañero y formulan recomendaciones para que este lo mejore: eso es peer assessment. A es incorrecta porque co-assessment supone una valoración compartida entre estudiante y docente, no únicamente entre pares. B es incorrecta porque self-assessment implica que cada estudiante analiza y valora su propio trabajo.

questions.text: Manolo's students are going to participate in a debate based on the statement "Animal testing should be banned." He wants them to focus on the use of the language function Acknowledging ideas. Considering the teacher's purpose, which set of expressions is appropriate to work on this function?
options: You are right! I also believe that... / I agree with you based on.... / My opinion builds upon ...'s idea.
From my perspective,... / I feel that... / I'm sure that...
In fact, it is not true that... / I'm afraid you'll have to do better than that. / You must reconsider...
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque las expresiones validan o reconocen la contribución del interlocutor antes de añadir una idea propia, que es la función de acknowledging ideas. B es incorrecta porque expresa principalmente la postura del hablante ("From my perspective...", "I feel that...") sin reconocer la idea del otro. C es incorrecta porque contradice y desafía al interlocutor; corresponde a refuting/disagreeing, no a acknowledging. TIP / RECUERDA: Acknowledging ideas = reconocer la contribución del otro antes de aceptar, desarrollar o conectar con ella.

questions.text: This winter, there's a good chance you might be (46)_________ for anything and everything to rid yourself of an annoying, lingering and sometimes debilitating cold.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque la combinación fija es "look for", que significa buscar, y en presente continuo forma "might be looking for". A es incorrecta porque "finding" significa encontrar y no forma la estructura "finding for" con este sentido. C es incorrecta porque "want" expresa deseo y en este contexto no se construye como "wanting for". TIP / RECUERDA: En phrasal verbs, la preposición forma parte de la expresión y debe aprenderse como unidad.

questions.text: You (47)__________ want to add yogurt to your list of cold-fighting remedies.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque "may want to..." expresa una sugerencia o posibilidad de manera prudente, apropiada para un texto informativo que no pretende imponer una recomendación. A es incorrecta porque "will" expresa mayor certeza y no encaja con el tono tentativo del artículo. B es incorrecta porque "must" expresa obligación, demasiado fuerte para una recomendación de este contexto. TIP / RECUERDA: En textos informativos, modales como may/might suelen suavizar recomendaciones y expresar posibilidad.

questions.text: ...there are some things in yogurt we can point to that, in theory, would be (48)__________.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque "advantageous" significa beneficioso o ventajoso y funciona con "would be" para describir posibles beneficios del yogur. B es incorrecta porque "supportive" suele referirse a algo que brinda apoyo, no a una propiedad beneficiosa del alimento en este contexto. C es incorrecta porque "profitable" se relaciona con ganancia económica, no con beneficios para la salud.

questions.text: ...probiotics, which can help (49)____________ the immune system.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque "boost the immune system" es una colocación establecida para expresar fortalecer o estimular el sistema inmunológico. A es incorrecta porque "promote" puede expresar favorecer o promover, pero no es la colocación natural usada aquí. C es incorrecta porque "rise" es intransitivo y no toma "the immune system" como objeto directo; además, no forma la colocación requerida. TIP / RECUERDA: Las colocaciones son combinaciones frecuentes que deben reconocerse como unidades: boost the immune system.

questions.text: However, specific benefits can only be (50)____________ to the actual strains studied...
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque "be attributed to" significa atribuir un efecto o beneficio a una causa o factor determinado, exactamente lo que exige el contexto científico. A es incorrecta porque "added to" significa añadido a algo, no atribuido a una causa. B es incorrecta porque "delivered to" significa entregado o administrado a alguien, sentido ajeno a la relación causal del enunciado.

questions.text: (51)__________, yogurt contains another immune stimulator: zinc.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque "Additionally" añade nueva información relacionada con la idea anterior: después de los probióticos, se incorpora el zinc como otro estimulante inmunitario. B es incorrecta porque "as well as" no funciona aquí como conector independiente al inicio de una oración con esta estructura. C es incorrecta porque "indeed" sirve principalmente para confirmar, reforzar o enfatizar una idea previa, no para añadir un nuevo punto.

questions.text: ...the 2 milligrams present (52)_________ an 8-ounce cup of yogurt.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque "present in" indica que una sustancia se encuentra contenida dentro de otra, como los 2 miligramos de zinc dentro de una taza de yogur. A es incorrecta porque "at" indica normalmente un punto o ubicación concreta, no contenido interno. B es incorrecta porque "on" se usa para superficies o contacto, no para algo que está dentro de un recipiente. TIP / RECUERDA: in = dentro de; on = sobre una superficie; at = punto/localización específica.

questions.text: Second, yogurt is a nutritious food choice (53)_________ probiotics are beneficial to health...
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque "since" puede introducir una cláusula causal completa: "probiotics are beneficial to health". A es incorrecta porque "because of" debe ir seguido de un sustantivo, pronombre o gerundio, no de una oración completa con sujeto y verbo. B es incorrecta porque "due to" sigue la misma pauta: introduce una causa expresada como frase nominal, no una cláusula independiente. TIP / RECUERDA: because/since + clause; because of/due to + noun or -ing form.

questions.text: ...but recommending them specifically for the common cold (54)__________ be premature.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque "would be premature" presenta una valoración prudente e hipotética sobre la recomendación: sería prematuro recomendarla específicamente para el resfriado. B es incorrecta porque "should be premature" no expresa de forma natural esa evaluación cautelosa en este contexto. C es incorrecta porque "ought to be premature" tampoco transmite la construcción idiomática que se necesita para esta valoración hipotética.

questions.text: Third, carbohydrates in yogurt (55)__________ energy, which helps you recover from a cold.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque "provide energy" es una colocación natural para expresar que los carbohidratos suministran energía al organismo. A es incorrecta porque "grant" se usa para conceder permisos, derechos o recursos, no para describir la función nutricional de un alimento. B es incorrecta porque "hand" significa entregar físicamente algo y no corresponde al proceso metabólico descrito.

questions.text: ...when women consumed yogurt every day for nine weeks, they (56)__________ reduced inflammatory markers in their blood.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es A porque "had reduced" mantiene la narración en pasado y presenta la reducción de marcadores inflamatorios como un resultado ya producido durante el período estudiado. B es incorrecta porque "has" es forma de presente para tercera persona singular y no concuerda con el sujeto "they" ni con el tiempo narrativo. C es incorrecta porque "have" es presente, mientras que el estudio se relata en pasado y se introduce con "when women consumed...".

questions.text: ...yogurt might be helpful in (57)_________ cold symptoms.
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque "fight off" significa combatir o hacer frente a una enfermedad o sus síntomas, por lo que encaja semánticamente con "cold symptoms". A es incorrecta porque "give up" significa rendirse o abandonar, un significado incompatible con síntomas. B es incorrecta porque "turn in" significa entregar algo o acostarse, y no forma una combinación adecuada con "symptoms". TIP / RECUERDA: Aprende phrasal verbs como unidades de significado, no palabra por palabra.

questions.text: (58)__________ the ability of yogurt to help fight a cold is theoretical right now, experts say there's no good reason not to choose yogurt...
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque "Though" introduce una concesión: aunque la capacidad del yogur para combatir el resfriado sigue siendo teórica, no existe una buena razón para evitarlo. A es incorrecta porque "So" introduce consecuencia, no contraste concesivo. C es incorrecta porque "Despite" necesita un sustantivo, pronombre o gerundio, mientras que aquí le sigue una cláusula completa ("the ability ... is theoretical"). TIP / RECUERDA: Though/although + clause; despite/in spite of + noun or -ing.

questions.text: Yogurt is (59)__________ and goes down easy, so if you have a sore throat...
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es C porque "smooth" describe una textura suave y cremosa que explica por qué el yogur "goes down easy", especialmente con dolor de garganta. A es incorrecta porque "dull" significa aburrido o poco intenso y no describe la textura del alimento. B es incorrecta porque "rough" significa áspero, una característica contraria a la sensación suave que necesita el contexto.

questions.text: So, choose yogurt (60)_________ its soothing texture and nutritional attributes...
questions.explanation: La respuesta correcta es B porque "choose yogurt for its soothing texture" usa "for" para expresar la razón o característica por la que se elige el producto. A es incorrecta porque "by" suele indicar medio, método o agente, no la razón de una elección. C es incorrecta porque "about" introduce el tema o asunto de algo, no el motivo de la elección.

questions.text: A teachers' meeting regarding pedagogical management documents is being held in a school. In this context, the teachers are sharing their ideas about school management that considers the values of the inclusive approach. Which of the following teachers' comments aligns with those values?
options: The school should help the students with disabilities achieve similar performances to those of their peers who do not have that condition.
The school should ensure that the students with disabilities have the same opportunities to learn as any other student.
The school should promote that the students with disabilities receive both specialized treatment and pedagogical attention.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque el enfoque inclusivo busca garantizar que todos los estudiantes tengan oportunidades equitativas de aprender, eliminando barreras y evitando exigir resultados homogéneos.

A es incorrecta porque plantea como meta que los estudiantes con discapacidad logren un rendimiento similar al de sus pares, lo que puede ignorar la diversidad y las necesidades educativas.

C es incorrecta porque coloca el tratamiento especializado como eje; la inclusión prioriza la participación y el aprendizaje, realizando los apoyos necesarios dentro de una respuesta educativa accesible.

TIP / RECUERDA: En inclusión, distingue igualdad de oportunidades y eliminación de barreras de la búsqueda de resultados idénticos para todos.

questions.text: During a meeting about the implementation of universal design for learning (UDL), the lead teacher offers some suggestions about resources that can be used to support students in the classroom. Below is one of those suggestions: 'When designing a learning session, it is necessary that the resources we use respond to the characteristics of our students. This way, we can offer texts, graphics, or audiovisual materials so that the students can learn without feeling limited by those resources.' Which of the following UDL principles is reflected in the suggestion above?
options: Provide multiple means of action and expression.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque el principio de representación del DUA se refiere a ofrecer distintas maneras de presentar y percibir la información.

A es incorrecta porque engagement se relaciona con cómo se motiva e involucra el estudiante, no con los formatos en que recibe la información.

C es incorrecta porque action and expression se refiere a las distintas formas en que el estudiante puede demostrar lo aprendido, no a cómo se presenta el contenido.

TIP / RECUERDA: Representación = cómo recibe la información; acción y expresión = cómo demuestra lo aprendido; compromiso = cómo se involucra.

questions.text: A talk about the attention to people with disabilities is being held in a school. Since there are students with physical disabilities at the school, the facilitating teacher suggests making some adaptations in the school playground. Below is one of the adaptation proposals shared by the facilitating teacher: 'To ensure that students with physical disabilities can enjoy the playground games, it is necessary to periodically maintain the ramps. Additionally, it is essential that the playground games with seats have sufficient safety features. Also, it would be appropriate to set up some rest areas in the playground.' Three teachers share their ideas about the proposal. Which of the following teachers' comments aligns with the inclusive approach?
options: I believe the proposal will promote the integration of the students. I mean that it will be easier for the students with physical disabilities to receive support from their peers to move around the playground, so everyone can enjoy the games.

I consider that, with the proposal, the care of students with physical disabilities is being prioritized. By implementing it, we will help prevent accidents in the playground while those students enjoy the games.

It seems to me that the proposal aims to create favorable conditions for the students with physical disabilities. This will help those students, as well as their peers, to freely enjoy the playground and the games.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque la propuesta modifica el entorno para eliminar barreras de acceso y permitir que los estudiantes con discapacidad y sus compañeros participen de manera autónoma.

A es incorrecta porque basa el acceso al juego en la ayuda de los pares, cuando una adaptación accesible debe favorecer la autonomía y reducir la dependencia de apoyos personales.

B es incorrecta porque se concentra en el cuidado y la prevención de accidentes de un grupo específico, mientras que el enfoque inclusivo busca condiciones de participación para todos.

TIP / RECUERDA: Inclusión no es solo asistencia; implica transformar el entorno para garantizar participación y autonomía.

questions.text: Alberto has noticed that some of his fourth-grade students write paragraphs that lack coherence, so he wants to help his students understand what coherence is. Which of the following activities is appropriate to achieve Alberto's purpose?
options: The teacher pairs up the students and hands out a paragraph to each pair. The paragraph has missing punctuation marks and misspelled words. The teacher asks the students to add the right punctuation and correct the misspelled words; then he invites some volunteers to read their answers aloud.

The teacher writes five pairs of simple sentences on the board. He pairs up the students and asks them to connect the sentences using conjunctions such as 'before,' 'after,' 'when,' and 'while.' Next, some students go to the board to connect each pair of sentences using the appropiate conjunction.

The teacher pairs up the students and provides them with an envelope containing strips of paper with written sentences taken from a paragraph. He asks the students to put the strips in the correct order so that the paragraph segments are logically connected. Then the teacher checks the correct order with the whole class.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque reconstruir el orden de las oraciones obliga a los estudiantes a identificar relaciones lógicas y a comprobar cómo las ideas se conectan para formar un párrafo con sentido.

A es incorrecta porque trabaja puntuación y ortografía; estos aspectos afectan la corrección formal, pero no enseñan directamente la coherencia global.

B es incorrecta porque practicar conectores puede apoyar la cohesión, pero unir oraciones aisladas no aborda por sí solo la organización lógica de un párrafo completo.

TIP / RECUERDA: Coherencia = relación lógica entre ideas; cohesión = recursos lingüísticos que conectan esas ideas.

questions.text: Marlene's students are going to have a group discussion on the following question: 'What are some challenges the next generation will face?' She asks her students to use some of the following expressions: • What's more, ... • Not to mention that ... • You also have to consider... Which of the following language functions corresponds to the expressions Marlene wants her students to practice?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque What's more, Not to mention that y You also have to consider... incorporan información o argumentos adicionales a una idea ya planteada.

B es incorrecta porque introducir un punto de vista implica presentar una opinión o postura, por ejemplo, In my opinion o From my perspective.

C es incorrecta porque expresar grados de certeza requiere marcar cuánta seguridad tiene el hablante, como en probably, maybe o certainly.

TIP / RECUERDA: Cuando una expresión agrega una razón o argumento a otro anterior, piensa en adding an argument.

questions.text:
*Pedro Padilla - My Amazing Jet Ski Experience Posted 3:17pm We went to Mirror Lake for our summer vacation. Our first day was so busy! People were sailing boats and water skiing, and there were a lot of jet skis and boats. We were watching some jet skiers, and then suddenly my mom said, 'Let's try the jet skis!' I was so excited! An instructor from the jet ski school explained how to ride the jet skis. Then we practiced near the beach. Toni and I learned how to go over waves, and after ten minutes, we were riding really fast! Then I rode with my mom, and my sister rode with my dad. It was such a memorable experience! Then we saw some dolphins. They're such awesome animals! They were swimming next to us. I'm looking forward to coming back again! # 4 comments Adapted from Styring J. & Tims, N. (2017). Metro 2. Oxford University Press.*

After Emilio's students read the text, he would like them to scan some information. Which of the following set of questions is appropriate for this purpose?
options: • Is this experience happening now or in the past? • Is Pedro's mother an adventurous person? Why? • Who is Toni?
• Where was the holiday? • Who is the blog's writer? • What activities did they do?
• Did they have a good day? • How did they feel doing the activities? • Did they feel tired at the end of the day? Why?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque las tres preguntas exigen localizar información explícita y puntual del texto: lugar, autor y actividades realizadas. Eso corresponde a scanning.

A es incorrecta porque preguntar si la madre es aventurera requiere interpretar una característica, no solo localizar un dato explícito.

C es incorrecta porque las preguntas sobre sentimientos y valoración implican interpretar y relacionar información, no buscar datos concretos rápidamente.

TIP / RECUERDA: Scanning = buscar datos específicos; gist = captar la idea general.

questions.text: At the following stage of the lesson, Emilio wants his students to work on the intensifiers 'so' and 'such' included in the text, since the students will use them later in their own writings to express intensity. He has planned three strategies to achieve his purpose. Which of the strategies Emilio has planned follows the inductive approach?
options: The teacher writes, on the board, some of the sentences from the text that have the intensifiers 'so' and 'such.' Then he pairs up the students and asks them to share ideas about when and why those intensifiers are used. Next, the teacher elicits the students' ideas orally. Finally, each pair creates their own examples.

The teacher displays a piece of flipchart that contains some sentences with the intensifiers 'so' and 'such' and explains how to use them. Then he asks the students to write some sentences using those intensifiers. After that, the students compare their sentences with a partner. Finally, some volunteers read their sentences aloud.

The teacher gives the students a worksheet about the intensifiers 'such' and 'so.' In the worksheet, there are two examples of each intensifier and sentences with blanks in them. The students analyze the examples provided and then fill in the blanks with the correct intensifier. Finally, the students check their answers in pairs.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque el enfoque inductivo parte de ejemplos concretos para que los estudiantes observen, comparen y formulen la regla antes de recibir una explicación explícita.

B es incorrecta porque el docente explica directamente cómo usar so y such antes de la práctica; eso corresponde a un enfoque deductivo.

C es incorrecta porque, aunque incluye análisis de ejemplos, la tarea está centrada en completar espacios y no en que los estudiantes formulen o descubran la regla.

TIP / RECUERDA: Inductivo = ejemplos → análisis → regla; deductivo = regla → ejemplos/práctica.

questions.text: Berenice is preparing her lesson for a reading session. She has noticed that the text for the next session is a recipe for a dish that is not popular in the students' community, so she has decided to make the text more meaningful for her students. Which of the following activities is more appropriate to carry out in order to achieve the teacher's purpose?
options: The teacher adapts the text by deleting some words the students may find difficult to understand before she gives a copy of it to each student. Next, the students read the text individually. Finally, the teacher calls on some volunteers to explain to the class what they have understood.

The teacher brings pictures that show the ingredients for the recipe mentioned in the text and sticks the pictures on the board. Next, the teacher elicits the names of the ingredients and writes them next to their corresponding picture. Finally, the teacher asks the students to read the text quickly and circle the ingredients.

The teacher asks the students to read the text and answer the following questions: Have you ever tried this dish? Would you like to try it? Why/Why not? Is there a similar dish in your country? How similar or different is it? Next, the students discuss the questions in pairs. Finally, some students share their answers aloud.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque hace que los estudiantes relacionen el contenido de la receta con sus experiencias, preferencias y referentes culturales, aumentando su significado personal.

A es incorrecta porque simplificar el vocabulario puede facilitar la comprensión, pero no establece una conexión personal o sociocultural con el contenido.

B es incorrecta porque activa vocabulario relacionado con los ingredientes, pero no invita a los estudiantes a vincular la receta con su propia realidad.

TIP / RECUERDA: Para hacer un texto significativo, busca conexiones con experiencias, conocimientos previos o el contexto del estudiante.

questions.text: During the past few sessions, Ursula's students have been talking about actions that started in the past but continue up to the present. During a semi-controlled group activity, she overhears a couple of students say: 'I have been to the movies last Saturday' and 'My mother has visited Piura last year'. Aware of the students' mistakes, Ursula wants to help her students correct their mistakes. Which of the following strategies is appropriate to carry out?
options: The teacher makes a pause and draws a timeline on the board. Then she elicits examples of activities the students have done recently and writes them on the timeline. Next, she asks the students to say when the actions started and if they have finished or not. Also, they analyze if it is important to specify the time. After that, the students retake the activity and say the sentences again correcting their mistakes.

The teacher stops the activity for a moment. Then she asks the students to pay attention to their peers' sentences and try to identify when they make mistakes using the target language. She tells them that every time a student identifies a mistake, they should correct it. Next, the students continue working on the activity. The teacher approaches the groups in order to provide help if needed.

The teacher approaches the students who have made mistakes and kindly explains to them how to use the target language correctly. After that, she gives the students some minutes to write, in their notebooks, some sentences using the target language correctly. Next, the students read their sentences aloud. Finally, the students go back to the task and continue with the group work.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque utiliza el error para que los estudiantes analicen el contraste entre present perfect y simple past y comprendan por qué expresiones de tiempo terminado como last Saturday y last year no corresponden al present perfect.

B es incorrecta porque convierte la actividad comunicativa en una búsqueda de errores entre compañeros y exige una capacidad metalingüística que no necesariamente está desarrollada.

C es incorrecta porque ofrece una explicación individual directa y desvía a los estudiantes de la tarea comunicativa, sin aprovechar el error como oportunidad de aprendizaje compartido.

TIP / RECUERDA: Present perfect se relaciona con el presente; simple past se usa con momentos pasados ya terminados y definidos.

questions.text: Amanda wants the students in her class to use the following expressions in a dialogue: • I'd rather go to ... • It's very kind of you, but... • Actually, I think I'm going to pass on it. • Let me sleep on it. Which of the following language functions is Amanda trying to promote with the expressions above?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque, consideradas en conjunto, las expresiones funcionan para declinar una invitación u oferta de manera cortés, indirecta y socialmente apropiada.

A es incorrecta porque disagreeing with an opinion consiste en contradecir una idea o postura, no en rechazar una invitación.

B es incorrecta porque I'd rather puede expresar preferencia, pero el conjunto de expresiones tiene como función comunicativa principal rechazar una propuesta o invitación.

TIP / RECUERDA: En preguntas de función lingüística, analiza el conjunto de expresiones y su propósito comunicativo, no una sola fórmula aislada.

questions.text:
*Josefina wants her fourth-grade students to improve their speaking skills through a class discussion. In order to achieve her purpose, she has planned the following teaching sequence: • First, the teacher asks her students what ideas come to mind when they listen to the word 'e-mail hacking.' The students brainstorm ideas and the teacher writes some of them on the board. • Next, she presents the following situation on the board: 'Two weeks ago, my e-mail account was hacked. I was shocked at first, so I did not take further action. A few days later, I opened a new e-mail account with a different password. Did I take the best action? Why/Why not? In your opinion, what could have been the ideal actions to take in that situation?' • Then the teacher writes the following expressions on the board: 'It seems to me that ...,' 'To my mind,...,' 'As far as I understand,...,' and 'From my perspective,...' • After that, the teacher forms groups of four students to discuss the questions shown in the situation. She encourages the students to use the expressions provided on the board, as well as the ideas they brainstormed at the beginning of the class. • The students have some minutes to discuss their ideas while the teacher walks around the class monitoring the activity. • Then the teacher gives a flipchart paper and markers to each group and asks them to make two lists: 'Actions to protect our e-mail accounts from hacking' and 'Suggestions on what to do when an e-mail is hacked.' • Next, each group presents their lists to the class: Two members of the group present the actions, and the other two present the suggestions. The audience asks further questions if they need clarification.*

Which of the following teaching methods is NOT involved in Josefina's sequence?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque la secuencia no sigue las tres etapas de PPP de manera lineal: el lenguaje aparece integrado en una situación problemática y en una tarea comunicativa.

B es incorrecta porque sí está presente el Problem-Based Learning: los estudiantes analizan una situación problemática, valoran decisiones y proponen soluciones.

C es incorrecta porque sí está presente el Task-Based Learning: los estudiantes colaboran para producir un resultado concreto y comunicarlo al grupo.

TIP / RECUERDA: PPP parte normalmente de presentación explícita, práctica controlada y producción; TBL organiza el aprendizaje alrededor de una tarea comunicativa.

questions.text: Which of the following speaking skills is least promoted in Josefina's sequence?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque, aunque la secuencia desarrolla la fluidez mediante discusiones y presentaciones y favorece la interacción con distintos interlocutores, no incluye una enseñanza explícita de recursos no verbales o paraverbales.

A es incorrecta porque discutir en grupos y presentar ideas ofrece oportunidades reales para comunicar mensajes de manera fluida.

C es incorrecta porque los estudiantes interactúan con compañeros del grupo y con la audiencia durante las presentaciones y preguntas.

TIP / RECUERDA: Recursos no verbales = gestos, postura, mirada; paraverbales = tono, volumen, ritmo y pausas.

questions.text: In the teaching sequence, Josefina presents the following situation: 'Two weeks ago, my e-mail account was hacked. I was shocked at first, so I did not take further action. A few days later, I opened a new e-mail account with a different password. Did I take the best action? Why/Why not? In your opinion, what could have been the ideal actions to take in that situation?' What is Josefina's main purpose when presenting the situation above?
options: Set the scene of the activity.
Promote the students' analysis of a situation.
Familiarize the students with language related to the topic.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque las preguntas exigen valorar una decisión y proponer alternativas, movilizando análisis y pensamiento crítico sobre una situación problemática.

A es incorrecta porque, aunque la situación establece el contexto de la actividad, su función principal no es solo ambientar, sino provocar el análisis de lo ocurrido.

C es incorrecta porque familiarizar con vocabulario del tema no constituye el propósito central de las preguntas planteadas; el foco está en juzgar y proponer acciones.

TIP / RECUERDA: Cuando una actividad pide evaluar decisiones, justificar posiciones o proponer alternativas, busca evidencias de análisis y pensamiento crítico.

questions.text: In the teaching sequence, Josefina writes the following expressions on the board: • It seems to me that ... • To my mind, ... • As far as I understand, ... • From my perspective, ... Which of the following language functions is she trying to promote with those expressions?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque It seems to me that, To my mind, As far as I understand y From my perspective introducen una postura o interpretación personal.

A es incorrecta porque estas expresiones no buscan dejar el mensaje impreciso; señalan claramente que lo que sigue corresponde al punto de vista del hablante.

B es incorrecta porque introducir hechos implica presentar información objetiva, mientras que estos marcadores presentan una valoración personal.

TIP / RECUERDA: Expresiones como in my opinion, from my perspective y to my mind suelen señalar la función de expresar opiniones.

questions.text: Finally, Josefina wants to wrap-up her lesson. Which of the following activities is better to achieve the teacher's purpose?
options: Tell the students to mention the most important things they have learned about e-mail hacking. Ask the students to share the solutions they consider more effective from the ones their classmates have presented.

Narrate the activities the students have done during the lesson so that they know the different steps they have followed. Mention the accomplished objectives of the lesson and the language they have learned.
Ask the students to think of another experience of e-mail hacking they have heard or read about recently. Invite some of the students to share the experience with the rest of the class.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque el cierre pide a los estudiantes identificar lo aprendido y valorar las soluciones presentadas por sus compañeros, favoreciendo reflexión y metacognición.

B es incorrecta porque coloca al docente como principal narrador de lo ocurrido; el cierre pierde su carácter reflexivo y centrado en el estudiante.

C es incorrecta porque introduce una experiencia nueva, pero no ayuda a sintetizar ni valorar los aprendizajes alcanzados durante la sesión.

TIP / RECUERDA: Un buen wrap-up recupera aprendizajes, promueve reflexión y ayuda a reconocer qué se aprendió y cómo se aprendió.

questions.text: It is almost the end of the school year, so Gabriel wants his fifth-grade students to write a speech for their graduation ceremony. Before the students write their speeches, he asks them the following questions: • Is a speech formal, semi-formal or informal? • What sequence markers should you use to organize your speech? • What words or phrases can you use to connect with the audience? What kind of questions is Gabriel using?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque las preguntas comprueban si los estudiantes comprenden las características del género speech: nivel de formalidad, organización y formas de conectar con la audiencia.

A es incorrecta porque content checking questions comprueban la comprensión del contenido o información específica, no de las características del género.

C es incorrecta porque instruction checking questions verifican qué deben hacer los estudiantes, por ejemplo, cantidad, modalidad o pasos de la tarea.

TIP / RECUERDA: CCQ = comprobar comprensión del concepto; ICQ = comprobar comprensión de la instrucción.

questions.text: Leopoldo's third-grade students have been doing several listening comprehension exercises using an audio about two people discussing the pros and cons of allowing students to use cell phones in school. Now, Leopoldo wants his students to develop their critical thinking skills. Which of the following activities is least appropriate to achieve his purpose?
options: The teacher asks the students to recognize how the speakers in the audio feel about the topic of allowing students to use cell phones in school. The students have to support their answers using keywords from the audio.

The teacher asks the students to decide if the ideas about the use of cell phones in school mentioned by the speakers are evident in their school as well. The students have to give examples based on their own experiences.

The teacher asks the students to mention whether they agree or disagree with the speakers' arguments for and against the use of cell phones in school. The students have to support their ideas and react to what their classmates have said.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque identificar cómo se sienten los hablantes y localizar palabras clave desarrolla comprensión del audio, pero no exige evaluar argumentos, contrastar perspectivas ni formular un juicio propio.

B es incorrecta porque sí promueve pensamiento crítico al transferir las ideas del audio al contexto de los estudiantes y pedir ejemplos que las sustenten.

C es incorrecta porque sí promueve pensamiento crítico al exigir una posición fundamentada y una respuesta a las ideas de los compañeros.

TIP / RECUERDA: Pensamiento crítico implica analizar, evaluar, justificar o transferir; localizar información por sí solo no es suficiente.

questions.text: Margarita's students are going to participate in a school presentation about the importance of keeping streets clean. She groups the students to practice their speeches for the presentation. While they are practicing, Margarita notices that her students hesitate quite often and start using Spanish fillers such as 'bueno' and 'este.' Thus, she wants to help her students sound more natural while they present their speeches. Which of the strategies below would be more appropriate for this purpose?
options: Approach the students who use Spanish fillers in a sentence and gently provide them with a proper filler in English such as 'Well...,' 'I mean...,' 'You know...,' and some others. Then ask the students to repeat their sentence using the filler provided.

Write, on the board, some common fillers in English and tell the students they can use them whenever they forget how to continue an idea. Next, encourage the students to use those fillers as they practice their speeches if necessary.

Tell the students to avoid using fillers as they make them sound less fluent when speaking or talking to others. Also, give the students more time for them to practice as many times as necessary until they know their speeches well enough.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque presenta fillers en inglés como recursos para mantener el turno y ganar tiempo mientras se organiza la siguiente idea, favoreciendo una producción oral más natural.

A es incorrecta porque la corrección inmediata interrumpe la fluidez durante la práctica y hace que el estudiante dependa del docente para seleccionar el recurso.

C es incorrecta porque eliminar los fillers no garantiza mayor naturalidad; además, memorizar el discurso palabra por palabra puede favorecer una producción rígida y poco espontánea.

TIP / RECUERDA: Fluency no significa hablar sin pausas, sino mantener la comunicación con naturalidad y estrategias para gestionar el discurso.

questions.text: Antonia's students are going to debate on the statement 'Junk food should be banned in schools.' She wants her students to use the following expressions while debating: • I beg your pardon? • Sorry to butt in, but... • I don't quite see what you mean. • Can I add something here? Which two language functions does Antonia want her students to practice?
options: Asking for information / arranging one's ideas.
Expressing lack of understanding / interrupting someone.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque I beg your pardon? y I don't quite see what you mean expresan falta de comprensión, mientras que Sorry to butt in, but... y Can I add something here? permiten interrumpir de manera cortés.

A es incorrecta porque ninguna de las expresiones tiene como función principal atribuir responsabilidad o culpar a alguien ni disculparse por una conducta específica.

B es incorrecta porque las expresiones no se centran en obtener información objetiva ni en organizar ideas de un monólogo, sino en gestionar la interacción durante el debate.

TIP / RECUERDA: En funciones comunicativas, identifica qué hace el hablante con la expresión: aclarar, interrumpir, disculparse, persuadir, etc.

questions.text: Tina's students have been talking about their favorite dish. Now, she wants them to participate in a communicative oral activity using that topic. Which of the following strategies is it more appropriate to carry out?
options: The students write the recipe of their favorite dish in their notebooks. Next, they read it aloud to the whole class. Finally, the teacher invites some volunteers to recall the ingredients mentioned in the recipe.

The students record a video in which they give instructions to prepare their favorite dish. The teacher asks the students to use simple language for their classmates to understand the instructions given. Finally, the teacher plays some of the videos in class.

The students ask five peers what their favorite dish is, why they like it and what ingredients it is made of. Then they compare and analyze the answers they got in order to find out similarities and differences. Finally, the students share their findings with the class.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque existe un propósito comunicativo real: obtener información de varios compañeros, comparar respuestas y compartir conclusiones. Hay intercambio y procesamiento de significado.

A es incorrecta porque leer una receta propia ante la clase es principalmente una producción unidireccional y no requiere intercambio real de información.

B es incorrecta porque el video es también una presentación preparada y unidireccional; escuchar videos después no constituye una interacción comunicativa entre los estudiantes durante la tarea.

TIP / RECUERDA: Una actividad comunicativa genuina suele incluir propósito, interacción, intercambio de información y necesidad de construir significado.

questions.text: During a reading session, Oswaldo's students are giving the text a first reading. While reading, a student raises his hand and asks the teacher for the meaning of the phrasal verb 'back up.' Which of the following actions is better for the teacher to carry out?
options: Tell the student that, at this point, it is important to understand the general idea. Then point out that there will be a moment to check vocabulary as a whole class. When the students finish reading, ask them to circle the words they don't understand in order to clarify their meaning.

Tell the student that the phrasal verb 'back up' is similar in meaning to 'support' or 'confirm,' but that it's more informal. Then give the student an example using 'back up.' After that, encourage the student to think of another situation in which he could use that phrasal verb.

Tell the student what a phrasal verb is and explain the meaning of 'back up' in English. If the student doesn't understand the meaning of that phrasal verb, translate it into Spanish. Finally, ask the student if he has problems with the meaning of other words in the text.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque en una primera lectura el objetivo es obtener el gist o idea general. Atender después el vocabulario permite evitar que una palabra desconocida interrumpa la comprensión global.

B es incorrecta porque explica un elemento léxico de inmediato y desplaza la atención de la primera lectura global hacia el detalle.

C es incorrecta porque añade una explicación extensa y traducción inmediata, apartando al grupo del propósito de comprender primero el sentido general.

TIP / RECUERDA: En reading for gist, no es necesario comprender cada palabra; primero construye una idea global del texto.

questions.text: Stefano's students are going to write a review of a movie they have seen recently. First, the teacher wants the students to get familiar with the elements of a movie review. Which of the following activities is most appropriate to achieve his purpose?
options: The teacher groups the students and gives each group two samples of movie reviews and a chart with the following labels: title, genre, actors and director, music, photography, and plot. Then the students read the samples and complete the chart listing the elements found.

The teacher hands each student a copy of a word search puzzle that contains a list of words related to the elements of a movie review. Then the students look for the words on the puzzle, circle them and compare their answers in pairs.

The teacher pairs up the students and asks them to answer the following questions: 'What's a movie review?' and 'What elements does it have?' Then the teacher elicits the answers from the students and clarifies doubts if necessary.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque los estudiantes analizan modelos reales de movie reviews y, mediante una tabla, identifican sus componentes. Esto permite reconocer la estructura y rasgos del género a partir de ejemplos.

B es incorrecta porque una sopa de letras trabaja principalmente reconocimiento léxico y no muestra cómo funcionan esos elementos dentro de una reseña.

C es incorrecta porque depende de que los estudiantes ya conozcan el género; preguntar por sus elementos sin analizar modelos ofrece menos andamiaje.

TIP / RECUERDA: Para familiarizarse con un género textual, los modelos auténticos permiten observar propósito, organización y recursos lingüísticos en contexto.

questions.text: Hugo's first-grade students are reading a short poem. Here is an excerpt of the poem: Up in the apple tree there is an apple so big and round... Climb up the tree and hold on tight Pick that round apple and take a big bite. Which of the following grammatical structures is the teacher mainly trying to promote with the poem?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque Climb up, hold on, Pick y take son verbos en imperativo que indican acciones directamente al interlocutor.

A es incorrecta porque, aunque aparecen palabras que pueden funcionar como adverbiales, no constituyen la estructura gramatical que organiza los versos.

B es incorrecta porque expresiones como a big bite no representan una práctica sistemática de cuantificadores como some, many o much.

TIP / RECUERDA: Imperative = base form del verbo para dar instrucciones, órdenes o indicaciones directas.

questions.text: Marcelo's first-grade students are practicing a conversation in which they are sharing personal information such as name, telephone number and e-mail address. He notices that some students have difficulties pronouncing phonemes such as b/v, c/z, m/n, a/e, i/y, and so on when spelling words. He wants to help his students pronounce those phonemes better. Which of the following strategies is appropriate to achieve the teacher's purpose?
options: Have the students use linking sounds.
Have the students recognize minimal pairs.
Have the students practice contrastive stress.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque los minimal pairs permiten distinguir fonemas que contrastan en un solo sonido, como /b/ y /v/ o /m/ y /n/, ayudando a percibir y producir la diferencia.

A es incorrecta porque linking sounds trabaja la conexión entre palabras en el habla continua, no la discriminación de fonemas aislados.

C es incorrecta porque contrastive stress modifica el énfasis prosódico para contrastar información, no la articulación de fonemas similares.

TIP / RECUERDA: Minimal pairs sirven para discriminación y producción de contrastes fonémicos.

questions.text: Victor's third-grade students have written a text in which they give advice to a friend. Now, the teacher is correcting the students' texts. Here is a comment he has written in one of the students' texts: 'This is a great text. You have included really useful pieces of advice to help your friend solve a problem. However, you could have used more of the expressions to give advice we studied in our previous sessions.' Based on the comment above, what was Victor's feedback focus?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque el comentario pide usar una mayor variedad de expresiones para cumplir la función de dar consejos. Se evalúa la amplitud y diversidad de recursos lingüísticos, es decir, el range.

A es incorrecta porque organization se refiere a cómo se estructura y relaciona el contenido del texto, no a la variedad de expresiones utilizadas.

B es incorrecta porque accuracy se centra en la corrección del lenguaje; el comentario no señala errores, sino falta de variedad.

TIP / RECUERDA: Accuracy = corrección; range = variedad y amplitud de recursos lingüísticos; organization = estructura del texto.

questions.text:
*Weekends at grandma's Ben loved spending his weekends at his grandma's house. Every Saturday morning, Ben's parents would take him to spend all the weekend with grandma. Her place was a cozy house with different plants and trees. Every Saturday, as soon as Ben arrived, he would run outside to look at the plants. He loved picking fruit such as strawberries, grapes and apples, as well as playing with grandma's cat inside the house. In the afternoon, grandma would cook with Ben's help. He always helped her prepare lunch. Grandma was an excellent and renowned cook in town, so every dish was awesome. During the evening, they would spend their time drawing pictures, playing games, and going for walks. Later, on Saturday night, Ben and grandma would make a delicious dinner and watch old movies together before going to bed. On Sunday, grandma would take Ben to the nearby park to feed the doves together. Then they would have some street food before Ben's parents pick him again. All in all, Ben cherished these wonderful memories with grandma and she loved sharing her passion for food with someone she loved so much. Adapted from ESLFast.com. (n.d.). Weekends at Grandma's. Retrieved July 10, 2025, from [URL].*

Romina has thought of three different strategies to have her students work on the text. Which of the following strategies she has thought of belongs to the top-down processing?
options: Group the students and provide each group with a set of cards. Each set of cards has some expressions from the text, as well as some pictures that depict those expressions. Ask the groups to match each expression with a picture. Next, provide each student with a copy of the text, ask them to read it and highlight the expressions they have seen some minutes ago.

Stick on the board some pictures related to the text. Ask the students to get in pairs and tell them to discuss what the story will be about based on those pictures. Then give each student a copy of the text and ask them to read it for a few minutes. Finally, encourage the students to say whether their guesses were right or wrong.

Write on the board a list of adjectives extracted from the text. Provide each student with a copy of the text with gaps in it to be filled with adjectives from the board. Next, pair up the students and ask them to fill in the gaps. Finally, ask some volunteers to share their answers with the whole class.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque el procesamiento top-down parte del contexto, conocimiento previo y predicciones globales para construir significado. Las imágenes permiten anticipar el contenido y luego comprobar las hipótesis al leer.

A es incorrecta porque parte de expresiones lingüísticas concretas y de su reconocimiento, un procedimiento más cercano al procesamiento bottom-up.

C es incorrecta porque se concentra en identificar palabras y completar elementos lingüísticos locales, también característico del procesamiento bottom-up.

TIP / RECUERDA: Top-down = del contexto y la idea general hacia los detalles; bottom-up = de unidades lingüísticas hacia el significado global.

questions.text: After the students have read the text, Romina wants them to understand the use of the transitions included in it. Which of the following strategies is more appropriate to carry out?
options: The teacher writes, on the board, five incomplete sentences and under each sentence three possible transitions to complete that sentence. Next, in pairs, the students have some minutes to choose the correct answer for each sentence. Finally, some volunteers say their answers aloud, and the teacher corrects if necessary.

The teacher pairs up the students and provides each pair with a list of other transitions. Next, she asks the students to replace the transitions from the text with some of the words from the list. Finally, the students compare their answers, and some volunteers read the texts to the whole class.

The teacher asks the students to circle all the transitions they see in the text. Then she pairs up the students and asks them to discuss what the purpose of each transition within sentences is. Finally, some students share their answers with the whole class, and the teacher clarifies doubts if needed.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque los estudiantes identifican las transiciones dentro del texto y analizan qué función cumplen en el discurso. Así comprenden la cohesión en contexto, no solo la forma aislada.

A es incorrecta porque presenta conectores en oraciones descontextualizadas, lo que limita el análisis de su función dentro de un texto completo.

B es incorrecta porque sustituir conectores mecánicamente no garantiza que el estudiante comprenda qué relación lógica expresa cada uno.

TIP / RECUERDA: Para aprender conectores, no basta reconocer la palabra; hay que comprender la relación que establece entre las ideas.

questions.text: Once the students have practiced different reading skills, Romina wants her students to work on a post-reading task. Which of the following activities is appropriate to achieve her purpose?
options: Ask the students to think of some questions to know more information about the characters. Next, group the students and ask them to work together to come up with the possible answers for those questions. Finally, tell the students to share their questions and answers with the class.

Stick a piece of flipchart paper with some expressions used to summarize information. Then pair up the students and ask them to say what the content of the text was by using some of the expressions provided. Finally, invite some volunteers to share their summaries with the rest of the class.

Write, on the board, some comprehension questions to be answered with information from the text. Ask the students to answer the questions individually. Group the students and tell them to compare their answers; then call some volunteers to read their answers to the whole class.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque la actividad amplía el trabajo después de la lectura: los estudiantes formulan preguntas sobre los personajes, elaboran posibles respuestas y comparten sus interpretaciones. Esto extiende la comprensión mediante inferencia y elaboración.

B es incorrecta porque resumir el contenido comprueba comprensión y síntesis, pero no extiende el texto hacia una nueva tarea de análisis o elaboración.

C es incorrecta porque se limita a responder preguntas literales con información explícita del texto, función típica de verificación de comprensión.

TIP / RECUERDA: Una tarea post-reading suele ir más allá de recuperar datos y puede implicar inferir, interpretar, crear o relacionar con otras experiencias.

questions.text: Finally, Romina wants her students to work on an extensive task as homework. Which of the following tasks is appropriate to assign?
options: The teacher asks the students to write a similar text, but using their own information. Also, she mentions that they have to include five or six linking words to connect their ideas. Finally, they will read their texts to the whole class during the following session.

The teacher brings copies of a text about people visiting someone loved. The text has some blanks in it for the students to complete with words that fit the context of the text. Finally, during the following session, the students compare their answers with a peer.

The teacher encourages the students to read a brief text related to the topic. She points out that they can choose the text they prefer. In the following session, the students will say if they liked the text they read or not and explain why.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque la lectura extensiva privilegia la elección del lector, una lectura relativamente amplia y el disfrute o comprensión general. La opción permite escoger el texto y luego compartir una reacción personal.

A es incorrecta porque exige producción escrita y el uso controlado de un número de conectores; el foco no está en la lectura extensiva.

B es incorrecta porque completar espacios es una tarea controlada de procesamiento lingüístico, no una lectura libre orientada al volumen y al disfrute.

TIP / RECUERDA: Extensive reading = elección, cantidad de lectura, fluidez y comprensión global; no análisis detallado palabra por palabra.

questions.text: Eulogio wants his third-grade students to infer information from the audio of a story. Which of the following activities develops that skill appropriately?
options: Ask the students to pay attention to the expressions the characters used in the story. Encourage the students to say if the characters know each other and explain why.
Ask the students to take notes on the most important ideas included in the story. Encourage the students to write a summary including that information.
Ask the students to choose the moment from the story they liked or didn't like the most. Encourage the students to support their ideas.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque los estudiantes deben deducir una relación que no se afirma directamente en el audio, utilizando pistas lingüísticas de cómo hablan los personajes. Eso es inferencia.

B es incorrecta porque tomar notas de ideas principales y elaborar un resumen se basa principalmente en información explícita y síntesis.

C es incorrecta porque expresar una preferencia personal y justificarla implica valoración, pero no necesariamente deducir información implícita del audio.

TIP / RECUERDA: Inferir = combinar pistas explícitas con conocimiento previo para llegar a una conclusión no dicha directamente.

questions.text: After having done some reading comprehension activities, Mario tells the students to paraphrase, orally, the review of the microwave oven, which is the following: I'm sorry to say I'm very disappointed with this microwave oven. It's big, awful and very heavy, so I can't carry it. It's also very difficult to use. So overall, it's definitely not worth the money and it's very poor value. Also, it was nearly two weeks late. My advice is don't buy it. Jen Swift Retrieved from Hugues, J. & Wood, K. (2019). Navigate Elementary. Unit 5 p 53. Oxford University Press. These are some of the students' samples. Which one shows paraphrasing skills?
options: Juan says: 'Jen is very mad at the company that sent her the product. I think the product is ugly and big so I wouldn't buy it. It was too expensive and didn't arrive on time. In my opinion, the product is terrible and the company, too.'

Alicia says: 'Jen is really unhappy with a product. The product is large, horrible, weighty and not easy to operate. In general, it is not good value for money. Besides, it arrived two weeks late approximately. She recommends not buying it.'

Lucia says: 'Jen is very disappointed with this product. It's big, awful, and very heavy so she can't carry it. It's also very difficult to use. It is definitely not worth the money and it's poor value. Also, it was nearly two weeks late. Her advice is don't buy it.'
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es B porque Alicia mantiene el significado del texto, pero lo reformula con vocabulario y estructuras diferentes: unhappy, weighty, not easy to operate, not good value for money, entre otras.

A es incorrecta porque incorpora opiniones que no aparecen en el original, por lo que deja de ser una reformulación fiel.

C es incorrecta porque conserva gran parte del vocabulario y la estructura original, por lo que se acerca a una repetición literal y no a una verdadera paráfrasis.

TIP / RECUERDA: Paraphrasing = mismo significado, distinta formulación; no es copiar ni añadir ideas propias.

questions.text: Mario wants his students to work on a meaningful extension activity in which they will write a product review. He has thought of three different activities. Which of the activities Mario has thought of is appropriate to achieve his purpose?
options: The teacher brings cards with the name of different products in each one. He asks the students to randomly pick a card. After that, they write a review of the product.
The teacher gives the students a review of a product. He asks them to highlight the key words in it. Then they rewrite the review substituting the key words.
The teacher tells the students to think about the products they have at home. He asks them to choose one of those products. Next, they write a review of it.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque escribir una reseña sobre un producto real que el estudiante conoce conecta la tarea con su experiencia y genera un propósito auténtico de comunicación.

A es incorrecta porque seleccionar un producto al azar puede impedir que el estudiante tenga experiencias o información suficientes para producir una reseña genuina.

B es incorrecta porque sustituir palabras de una reseña modelo es una práctica de manipulación lingüística, no una extensión significativa basada en la experiencia del estudiante.

TIP / RECUERDA: Una tarea meaningful conecta el lenguaje con experiencias, intereses o necesidades reales del estudiante.

questions.text: Daniel's fourth-grade students are going to give an oral presentation about pollution effects in the environment. He provides the students with a list of expressions to be used during the presentation. Here are some of those expressions: • I'd like to put the situation into some kind of perspective. • I'd like you to think about the significance of this figure here. • Whichever way you look at it, the underlying trend is clear. Which of the following language functions is involved in the expressions provided by the teacher?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque las expresiones llaman la atención del público sobre información relevante, datos o tendencias que el presentador considera importantes. Esa es la función de highlighting information.

B es incorrecta porque introducing the topic se usa para presentar el tema o propósito de la exposición, normalmente al inicio.

C es incorrecta porque sequencing events organiza hechos o ideas mediante relaciones de orden, por ejemplo, first, then, finally.

TIP / RECUERDA: Highlighting guía la atención del oyente hacia lo relevante; no necesariamente introduce el tema ni ordena eventos.

questions.text: Before listening to the radio spot, Florencia wants to activate her students' prior knowledge on the topic in a communicative way. Which of the following strategies is it appropriate to carry out?
options: Bring a word search puzzle with some words related to the Pan American and Parapan American Games. Give the students some minutes to find the words in the word search puzzle. Finally, ask the students to get in pairs and compare the words they found.

Give each student a worksheet with a matching exercise about the Pan American and Parapan American Games. The exercise has two columns with phrases under each column. Tell the students to choose one phrase from each column and connect them in order to make a sentence.

Write the title 'Pan American and Parapan American Games 2019' on the board. Provide the students with prompts such as: 'I think that...,' 'Some sports played at this event are...,' etc. Ask the students to stand up, find a peer and start a dialogue about the games using the prompts provided.
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es C porque los estudiantes recuperan conocimientos sobre el tema mediante un diálogo guiado con un compañero y utilizan expresiones que les ayudan a compartir lo que ya saben.

A es incorrecta porque una sopa de letras se centra en reconocer palabras y no genera interacción oral significativa sobre el tema.

B es incorrecta porque el ejercicio de emparejar frases trabaja principalmente forma lingüística y no activa conocimientos previos mediante comunicación auténtica.

TIP / RECUERDA: Activar saberes previos de manera comunicativa implica recuperar ideas y ponerlas en uso mediante interacción, no solo reconocer vocabulario.

questions.text: Florencia asks her students to listen to the following radio spot: 'The Pan American and Parapan American Games are about to start. There will be athletes from different countries such as USA, Brazil, Mexico, Canada, Cuba, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Venezuela, Jamaica and some others. Don't miss this opportunity to see sports like basketball, handball, bowling, boxing, badminton, baseball and many more. Look for information about venues, ticket prices, dates and schedules at www.lima2019.pe' Then she asks the students to come up with a phrase or sentence that expresses what the audio is about. Which of the following listening skills is being developed through this activity?
questions.explanation:
La respuesta correcta es A porque pedir una frase que indique de qué trata el audio exige identificar y expresar su idea general o gist.

B es incorrecta porque predicting content ocurre antes de la escucha, cuando el estudiante anticipa de qué tratará el audio a partir de pistas.

C es incorrecta porque listening for details exige recuperar información específica, como nombres, deportes, fechas o precios.

TIP / RECUERDA: Después de escuchar, "What is it about?" apunta al gist; "What exact information?" apunta a detalles específicos.
